Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. This is bad, folks.
**A brand new GOP super PAC placed a massive ad buy in New Hampshire — just as we made huge cuts to our ad budget.**
We knew something like this would happen – last-minute attacks aren't new. But what we didn't expect was that we wouldn't be prepared to fight back.

name: Lawrence W. Reed
subject: Jesus was NOT a socialist
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61725406:60YvTjGXN:m:1:3317145305:45387B883AD0E42C38EAA9F7D44169D6:r)
Hello Peter,

The Left likes to say that Jesus would be a liberal socialist if He were on earth today, but that is simply not true.

Too many people want to take the Bible out of context to justify modern ideological movements like socialism and Marxism.

To understand why this is a lie, it's important to know **what** socialism means. A century ago, it was widely regarded as government ownership of the means of production. Today, socialism is progressively ramped up through central planning of the economy.

And Jesus never even hinted at that concept, let alone endorsed it.

Yet the definition has changed over time.

You can scour the New Testament, but you won't find a word from Jesus that calls for empowering politicians or bureaucrats to allocate resources, pick winners and losers, tell entrepreneurs how to run their businesses, impose minimum wages or maximum prices, compel workers to join unions, or even to raise taxes.

Peter, Christianity is not about passing the buck to the government when it comes to relieving the plight of the poor. **It 's about doing it ourselves**! That's why we need to bring pro-liberty, pro-Christian policies back into our society.

I have talked a lot about this with Dr. Norman Horn, founder and president of the Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI). He's a leader in the liberty movement with an organization dedicated to bringing back sound economic principles to Christians across the world. And I recently told him that I would help achieve LCI's mission of raising $10,000 this month.

[_**Can you join me and the Libertarian Christian Institute in the fight against socialism? Peter, please send a gift of $25, $35, $50, or any amount today by clicking here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61725406:60YvTjGXN:m:1:3317145305:45387B883AD0E42C38EAA9F7D44169D6:r)

If you think Jesus meant for politicians to take care of people with police power at twice the cost and half the effectiveness of private charity, you're not reading the same New Testament I am.

In Jesus's Parable of the Good Samaritan, the traveler is regarded as "good" because he personally helped the stricken man at the roadside with his own time and resources.

If, instead, he had urged the helpless chap to wait for a government check to arrive, we would likely know him today as the _Good-for-Nothing_ Samaritan.

Christian charity, **being voluntary and heartfelt** , is utterly distinct from the compulsory, impersonal mandates of the state.

And with your help, LCI can spread this message across the country.

**Can I count on you to join us with an urgent gift today? Click below to donate.**

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61725407:60YvTjGXN:m:1:3317145305:45387B883AD0E42C38EAA9F7D44169D6:r)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61725411:60YvTjGXN:m:1:3317145305:45387B883AD0E42C38EAA9F7D44169D6:r)

[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61725406:60YvTjGXN:m:1:3317145305:45387B883AD0E42C38EAA9F7D44169D6:r)

Christians are integral to defending liberty, preserving morality in our culture, and opposing the evils of empires.

The Libertarian Christian Institute envisions a world where Christians promote the values and principles of a free society, not socialism and aggression.

LCI sees a world where Christians demonstrate that individual liberty is a force for the common good, and aims to persuade Christians that the political expression of our faith inclines us toward the principles of individual liberty and free markets.

**Simply put, LCI was created to make the Christian case for free markets and free people. **

[_**Can you join me and the Libertarian Christian Institute in the fight against socialism? Peter, please send a gift of $25, $35, $50, or any amount today by clicking here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61725406:60YvTjGXN:m:1:3317145305:45387B883AD0E42C38EAA9F7D44169D6:r)

Thank you,

Lawrence W. Reed

Christian charity, being voluntary and heartfelt , is utterly distinct from the compulsory, impersonal mandates of the state. And with your help, LCI can spread this message across the country. Can I count on you to join us with an urgent gift today? Click below to donate. Christians are integral to defending liberty, preserving morality in our culture, and opposing the evils of empires. The Libertarian Christian Institute envisions a world where Christians promote the values and principles of a free society, not socialism and aggression. LCI sees a world where Christians demonstrate that individual liberty is a force for the common good, and aims to persuade Christians that the political expression of our faith inclines us toward the principles of individual liberty and free markets. Simply put, LCI was created to make the Christian case for free markets and free people. Thank you, Lawrence W. Reed We equip followers of Jesus Christ to make the Christian case for a free society. body:
This is my story [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0902%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=%2ftHeumTKvQ0qe9Tfbjq%2fHg&sysid=1)
This is my story

| |
---
| | | Hi, I’m Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47323%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D0oCdUTBnBtoiJysl6njcA&sysid=1 "Adam 1")
---

I didn’t know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I’ll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47324%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NN1D%2fO0kKSNv2YOtE9KvFQ&sysid=1 "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn’t always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could’ve accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47335%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=H1F6a15MoORuo%2bEECYSF9w&sysid=1 "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47336%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=occX4vCVkJFeBIGk0BrBuA&sysid=1 "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn’t done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada’s Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47337%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nC1Zml5yQlXdYCAj9d7paw&sysid=1 "Adam 5")
---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They’re the reason I’m running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47338%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jOQsIANPHwIdZJo1BlJk9g&sysid=1 "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and
fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Please, step up now before it’s too late.

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM LAXALT](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c47339%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SmFXzrhFjgIwxSUdxlt7kQ&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM LAXALT")
---

I know with your support, we can save this country we both love so much.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt

---

body:

| This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z171h9ua2cs2790hpipc5qhcv0soha905ervo378_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdie4p34c5h2bs)
---|---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z50aptnca22illglm2ugtl4umuhjsnl120pdlnv8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdie4p34c5h2bs)

subject: Urgent: potential landslide win for abortion in November
body:
As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

| [ ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbenpd27mgo50ei1q48gt9ac9eb8rr4122pb1s4o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdie4o34sph2bs)

#
Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have been poured by donors into pro-abortion groups. They have one goal in mind: use this mountain of cash to fuel a landslide win for pro-abortion candidates this November.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups across the country are struggling to keep up as donors have stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v. Wade as the end of the battle when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate courageous pro-life people before midnight tonight so we can stay in the fight and reach 34,000 moms before it’s too late. Will you take a stand with us? Give now: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2d2jj8q8gosnss2cvqsefn6sipd5uh6s7v0o44o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdie4o34sph2bs)**

Friend of Life - this is a David vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education - and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that Americans reject the Court’s ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls show that Americans are increasing in their support of abortion-on-demand and even pro-life states could be on the verge of expanding abortion in the next few months. The 24/7 media barrage funded by committed pro-abortion donors is working and if we don’t move quickly, all of our progress over the last 40 years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your gift RIGHT NOW will save babies from being poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother’s wombs: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4kuiv0s0m4v6emkq8arn1fgcknu08hccbrdting_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdie4o34sph2bs)**

Your unwavering conviction and commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We will prevail in every state and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

**Lila Rose**
Founder and President

subject: Urgent: potential landslide win for abortion in November
body:
As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

| [ ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8jpcrsp2tvg704vt2mlu5haiu85vu677r40b0i8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdieeob0c3h2bs)
---
#
Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have been poured by donors into pro-abortion groups. They have one goal in mind: use this mountain of cash to fuel a landslide win for pro-abortion candidates this November.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups across the country are struggling to keep up as donors have stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v. Wade as the end of the battle when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate courageous pro-life people before midnight tonight so we can stay in the fight and reach 34,000 moms before it’s too late. Will you take a stand with us? Give now: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z14ii6fi7fdnqorvcuvqv5crbb8jd79ib82nknrg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdieeob0c3h2bs)**

Friend of Life - this is a David vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education - and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that Americans reject the Court’s ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls show that Americans are increasing in their support of abortion-on-demand and even pro-life states could be on the verge of expanding abortion in the next few months. The 24/7 media barrage funded by committed pro-abortion donors is working and if we don’t move quickly, all of our progress over the last 40 years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your gift RIGHT NOW will save babies from being poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother’s wombs: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zc6hg86n9ipogto4r3tommdplvhp6dov2civnnho_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdieeob0c3h2bs)**

Your unwavering conviction and commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We will prevail in every state and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

**Lila Rose**
Founder and President

| | | Hi, I'm Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61728044:6pAArjGNC:m:1:3364136623:532F48F45DE9498AF5D97FE597B8C66F:r "Adam 1")
---

I didn't know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I'll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61728044:6pAArjGNC:m:1:3364136623:532F48F45DE9498AF5D97FE597B8C66F:r "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn't always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could've accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61728044:6pAArjGNC:m:1:3364136623:532F48F45DE9498AF5D97FE597B8C66F:r "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61728044:6pAArjGNC:m:1:3364136623:532F48F45DE9498AF5D97FE597B8C66F:r "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn't done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada's Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61728044:6pAArjGNC:m:1:3364136623:532F48F45DE9498AF5D97FE597B8C66F:r "Adam 5")
---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They're the reason I'm running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That's why I'm asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61728044:6pAArjGNC:m:1:3364136623:532F48F45DE9498AF5D97FE597B8C66F:r "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in
Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Please, step up now before it's too late.

I know with your support, we can save this country we both love so much.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt

| | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win in November.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3c98d061-b530-4c9f-ad74-780494a10b06/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

Hey there, Derek — I’m coming to you directly to explain why it’s so important that you get involved in this race today.
Pennsylvania is a critical battleground state — who we elect as our next Governor will have a lot of power. The power to protect abortion, defend voting rights, help people get ahead, and tackle the big fights facing Pennsylvania.
They’ll also have the power to appoint the Secretary of State who will oversee the 2024 election. With Donald Trump likely running for president again, it’s critical we have a Governor who will defend the results of the election — instead of overturning the results to install Trump in the White House.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b6f8c54314dd412095072de67f76701f&_e=sqmW5j5mSRmm4yLt5p97JL8VvCfV0igkDyJ3ncmfi70XdWNOAl1J0-nwm2CIrby4WuV-BLQxq-hUUENz0gZCkDOEscNorlvj2G7CGFoGBtbcTBMXtSqBij7mzFNlYHTSHZVW-iFZ3JyaoFmzRaDX83P-9-LxyXyLZJLcbMTaDdgGKJcP55mMxMKagmF4FVzXrGdUtPoTOggkAIv4W5ZrvLmj2mq5cz-mwdls9Jrs1w6VUVSoekLazHjzZorHT0PzrRGPPaB2AazxDxXdnFUoHjC_VvUZvrQ0Wc1P8EFo4bSjzW3NHqH1FVy0Cko3WJltKQklodrw99RubIi6sMqo2ASMIIf0LOTABYXvTXTXDeep0V_G-4fmf9IFoBfIS7tsiNMABzR_R2ZZjtsQy_5JKg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. subject: The gravy train
body:
Friends, For years, we have talked about Stacey Abrams' shady network of political organizations - and cronies - who work in concert to champion thei
| |
---
|
---
Friends, For years, we have talked about Stacey Abrams' shady network of political organizations - and cronies - who work in concert to champion their fearless leader and advance her radical agenda. We've also mentioned that all of the above (including Abrams) are making big money along the way. Recently, we were reminded how much money you can make by being a loyal foot solider for a failed gubernatorial candidate. There's no doubt that the grift is real! **Fox News: Stacey Abrams' group funnels thousands to director's family and friends with no political experience** [According to a Fox News investigation, "The Abrams-founded Fair Fight PAC is funneling the cash to individuals close to her longtime aide Andre Fields, who acts as the PAC's political director...Fields' sister, Darius Faulk, is one of the cash recipients. The Fair Fight PAC has disbursed more than $120,000 to her for training consultant services since August 2021."](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3335280.612.1.17085c99097bccb0147dea2c648e40e5) **Politico: Abrams’ campaign chair collected millions in legal fees from voting rights organization** And this week, numerous media outlets reported that ["Fair Fight Action, the nonprofit founded by Abrams, paid her close friend and ally’s law firm $9.4 million in 2019 and 2020, with two more years of billing yet to be disclosed."](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3335280.613.1.2816bbd9d250fa32ff1e1b34de2fd737) This type of behavior is commonplace for Team Abrams and it has created distrust - even amongst Georgia Democrats - for years. Back in 2015, Abrams and her voter registration group, New Georgia Project, were under [intense scrutiny](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3335280.614.1.2dd0b3f1b9055f9d7da81ebc710a00a5) after failing to register a consequential number of voters - despite raising $4 million. **"Democratic donors and strategists gathered at a Midtown Atlanta law firm to discuss what went wrong. When the New Georgia Project’s work came under question, several who attended the meeting described a sharp inquiry that mirrored questions resonating in political circles: Where did the money go?"** When you peel back the onion, you find that another organization in Abrams' network, Third Sector Development, plays a huge role in this scheme. Founded in 1998, Third Sector Development is the group Stacey Abrams used as a clearinghouse for the 2014 voter registration drive. Upon review of tax returns and public filings, the organization paid Abrams $177,500 in 2014 and nearly $400,000 on a handful of key staffers and consultants. And as they say...the rest is history. Abrams leveraged that network for political and personal gain. Once indebted to the IRS, Abrams is now a multi-millionaire - and celebrity - who lives a lavish lifestyle while claiming to be fighting for the people. This November, we have an opportunity to derail the Stacey Abrams' gravy train once and for all. [Chip in $100 right now](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3335280.615.1.a0c536a5a999e0666e63cd3a0768e974) and help us expose her network for what it really is: a scam! subject: Are you safe in CA?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brian Dahle for Governor 2022
body:
|
---
| |
---
| Hi ,

The crime rate has skyrocketed over the last four years under Gavin Newsom.

And who’s paying for it? Families.

This year alone we’ve witnessed story after story of battery, theft, and even mass shootings here in Gavin’s own town of Sacramento.

Earlier this year at family-friendly McKinley park in Sacramento, a young mother was randomly assaulted by a homeless man as she was trying to buckle her young children into their seatbelts.

Months later, there was a mass shooting in downtown Sacramento leaving bullet holes in the building where my own son works.

Mothers shouldn’t have to be afraid of taking their children to the park.

Young men shouldn’t have to be afraid of working in a business district in downtown Sacramento.

But what’s even more shocking is how unaware Californians are at the policies that are to blame for this rise in crime.

In fact, in recent years of disastrous progressive policy implementation, we’ve seen:
* **Newsom vow to close two more prisons **
* **Reclassification of felony offenses as misdemeanors**
* **Parole overhaul allowing prisoners to be released earlier**
* **Reduction of punishment for those convicted of theft **
* **My family, and your family are paying the price for this blatant disregard of human safety**

**This is important:** If you want this to stop, if you want you and your family to be safe, then now is the time to act.

We need everyone who can to chip in so that we can raise awareness to Californians everywhere that their safety is my #1 concern.

Thank you so much for everything you can do.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

name: Blake Masters
subject: I want you to know why I’m running to take back Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blake Masters for Senate**
body:
I wanted to reach out personally | I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election...

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)

Peter,

Do you have a minute?

I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election, I wanted to take the time to reach out personally.

Let me start by telling you about myself and why I felt compelled to run for Senate: Arizona has helped shape my life for the better \- and I owe this state so much. I grew up here and am proud to still call Arizona home, along with my incredible wife Catherine and our three boys.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)

That's why it's so deeply troubling to see what the failed leadership of the Biden administration and my opponent, Mark Kelly, have done to our nation.

Whether it is _**dangerous criminals**_ pouring across our unsecured border, _**crushing inflation**_ that is killing family-owned businesses, or _**teaching toxic ideologies**_ to our children, Democrats are destroying the America we know and love.

This country deserves so much better, **and I 'm running to create a more prosperous future for ALL Americans.**

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)

**[HELP DELIVER A BETTER FUTURE FOR ARIZONA AND AMERICA.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)**

I know what it takes to tackle difficult problems and build success from scratch. I'm an America First outsider who has spent my career in the private sector creating jobs and investing in our youth. I'm committed to bringing YOUR voice to Washington _**and won 't EVER back down from fighting to put America First.**_

Let me be absolutely clear - _I 'm not interested in the political games of Washington._ I'm running for Senate because decent, hard-working people like **YOU** deserve solutions to the problems you face on a daily basis.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)

We all know what is at stake on November 8th: The future of our state, our country, and control of the Senate. It is beyond critical that we restore **competent, conservative leadership** in Washington.

My race is extremely close and will be decided in this campaign's final days and weeks. I'm confident that united, we WILL win this election for the America First movement and begin building a better future for our nation. I'd be honored to have your support in this critical fight.

**[PLEASE CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN THIS ELECTION FOR THE AMERICA FIRST MOVEMENT.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters
U.S. Senate Candidate from Arizona

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730040:JbCYYjGiN:m:1:3374627611:F42EBFF37E1DDFC624453BCEEC99803D:r)**

Friends,
Despite many state officials and our representatives in D.C. trying to tell us differently, we are experiencing a public safety crisis across America. On our streets, in our schools and at our southern border, lawlessness is tearing our communities apart. The recent deliberate, fatal attack on Bristol police officers responding to a domestic violence call has shocked our state and law enforcement agencies across America.
We need real leaders who will step up, support victims rather than the perpetrators of crime and who will pledge to be a champion for the brave men and women putting their lives on the line everyday to keep us safe.
Our police officers need to be and feel supported within our communities. The anti-law enforcement rhetoric, coming from Washington and even from state and local officials, needs to change. Friend,

I hope you’ll forgive me for my language in that tweet. I can get pretty passionate when it comes to saving our democracy.

I’m emailing you two weeks from what could be the most important election in the history of our country. The fact is, our democracy is in danger. And we can talk about what’s going on in various states and various polls and predictions, but what it really comes down to is this: **We either protect our democracy this year, or we don’t.

I’m asking you to commit to vote.** Commit to getting your family and friends to vote. Commit to encouraging your community to vote. Do everything you can. Because that’s the best tool we have in a democracy in order to protect it.
[Go to iwillvote.com for information and resources](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53269322/374941146/-1612268846?refcode=20221025.5r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMyMjZiNzhjLTVjNTQtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LUcGI9c2lT8J-QiicVXjw35sMFovCLKsFX7XgEcl8sY=&emci=4a35cc4b-bd53-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=3226b78c-5c54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=8431045)
---
Growing up, the successes of the Civil Rights movement inspired me and motivated my entry into public service. That generation achieved victories that many didn’t think were possible. They did that because they believed in the ideals of this country and realized the promise of democracy for more and more Americans.

Fifty years from now, will people look back and think, **that was the generation that failed to protect democracy?**

No, friend. That can’t happen – it can’t be allowed to happen. I’ll fight, and I know you will, too. And if we put enough of ourselves into the fight, we CAN win.

The first and most important step is to vote and to encourage our communities to vote. [**_Go to iwillvote.com, find the information you need, and make a plan: when, where, and how you’ll vote._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53269323/374941147/-1612268846?refcode=20221025.5r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMyMjZiNzhjLTVjNTQtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LUcGI9c2lT8J-QiicVXjw35sMFovCLKsFX7XgEcl8sY=&emci=4a35cc4b-bd53-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=3226b78c-5c54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=8431045) Then share the information with the people around you and ask them to do the same.

We can win this fight, friend, I know we can.

Thank you for everything you do,
Eric H. Holder, Jr.

name: Raphael Warnock
subject: I'm humbled
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |
---
Friend: Today, I wanted to reach out and tell you a little bit about myself. My story speaks to exactly why I'm in this fight – and it's important I share that with you.

First, here's a picture of me as a kid with a few of my siblings! (I'm in the bottom-right corner.)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53269406/374941486/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4592-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTI2Yjc4Yy01YzU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NS0eN-rt5yDxlPIsBxdSErJDSziHQYOMszBcVny-zSo=)
I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah, Georgia. I had 11 brothers and sisters – and while my family was short on money, we were long on love and faith. My parents taught us the meaning of hard work and always said we could do _anything_ we put our minds to. Thanks to their support, I became the first in my family to earn a college degree.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53269408/374941489/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4592-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTI2Yjc4Yy01YzU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NS0eN-rt5yDxlPIsBxdSErJDSziHQYOMszBcVny-zSo=)
From there, I followed in the footsteps of my mom and dad – both preachers – and eventually worked my way up to become the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta, the spiritual home of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.

Peter,

Last night, Governor DeSantis took the debate stage against Charlie Crist – going head-to-head on the top issues Floridians are facing.

With every question, Governor DeSantis delivered logic, facts, and his record of success, while Charlie relied on dodging questions, rewriting history, and out-right lying to get through the hour.

Charlie Crist knows he can’t debate on merits alone, so he resorts to dirty tricks and tactics to distract from the fact that he simply has no real plan or agenda of his own and is merely a vessel for the Biden Regime.

Right now, out-of-touch millionaire donors are pouring money into Charlie’s campaign hoping to flip Florida blue and allow Charlie Crist to hand over the keys to the failed Biden administration.

Make no mistake, Peter, if the far-Left takes control of Florida, they will do to Florida what Joe Biden has done to America.

We cannot let that happen.

We MUST stand up and protect our state, our families, our businesses, our children’s education, and our freedom from far-Left extremism.

With just 14 days until Election Day, we don’t have a moment to spare.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8e2662c866a0fd057c316ee8b427823431bc2d95709d85a800f831f24f9b9510b3e55bacd7593fccf79068fcf7a7ba9cf5d519eca26e6e2b
>>">We are counting on you to ACT NOW to Keep Florida Free >>>

For Florida,

Team DeSantis

From: Ron DeSantis <

reply@email.rondesantis.com >

To: <dpwillis67@gmail.com>
Subject: I just stepped off the stage

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8e2662c866a0fd057c316ee8b427823431bc2d95709d85a800f831f24f9b9510b3e55bacd7593fccf79068fcf7a7ba9cf5d519eca26e6e2b

Peter,

I just stepped off the debate stage, and it’s now clearer than ever — Charlie Crist is dangerous for Florida.

His allegiance to the far-Left’s extreme agenda puts Floridians at risk of facing the same fate as other failed blue states around the country.

On every topic, Charlie Crist takes the most extreme stance — right in line with the Democrat Machine.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8e2662c866a0fd057c316ee8b427823431bc2d95709d85a800f831f24f9b9510b3e55bacd7593fccf79068fcf7a7ba9cf5d519eca26e6e2b
REJECT CHARLIE'S EXTREME AGENDA

Over the course of the night, Charlie cemented for Floridians that:

▪️ He votes 100% of the time with Joe Biden, and like the rest of the Democrats, he wants the government to control your kids. If it were up to Charlie, Florida schools would subject students to forced COVID jabs and indoctrination with woke ideologies.

▪️ If it were up to Charlie, Florida would be a sanctuary state. He cares more about advancing Biden’s open border agenda than keeping Floridians safe.

▪️ Charlie’s jailbreak agenda is in lockstep with the radical pro-crime views of Soros-affiliated prosecutors who are allowing criminals to wreak havoc in cities across our nation. His rejection of law and order would put Floridians in danger.

▪️ Charlie spent the last two years serving as a rubber stamp for the Biden Regime and wants nothing more than to bring the Biden Regime’s destructive policies to Florida.

What's more, Peter, Charlie only showed up to work 14 days this year, because he isn’t interested in performing the duties of the many offices he has run for in his political career spanning five decades. How many jobs pay you $174,000 a year to only show up to work 14 days??

Not surprising coming from Biden’s biggest cheerleader.

Throughout the night, Charlie dutifully played his role as a political puppet for the Biden Regime.

Since day one of his campaign, Charlie has praised Biden’s failed policies and declared at every opportunity that he considers Joe Biden the “greatest president of our lifetime” — yes, the same Biden who has been plunging our country into a downward spiral since he took office.

Charlie made clear that, if elected, he will continue to take his orders from a puppet who can hardly read from a teleprompter.

Truth be told, Peter, I’m wary of any candidate who matches Biden’s agenda, rhetoric, and confused, empty gaze. I think I can speak for most Floridians when I say they don’t want another Joe Biden running this state.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8e2662c866a0fd057c316ee8b427823431bc2d95709d85a800f831f24f9b9510b3e55bacd7593fccf79068fcf7a7ba9cf5d519eca26e6e2b
KEEP BIDEN'S PUPPET OUT OF FLORIDA

My opponent talked a lot about decency, Peter, I’m not really sure what’s decent about locking people in their homes, destroying their businesses, and keeping children out of school.

Aside from comparing himself to Tom Brady and Jesus Christ, I can’t think of anything more ridiculous than Charlie Crist asking Floridians to trust him.

In the end, Charlie lost the fight to shut down schools, lost the fight to shut down businesses, lost the fight to lock people in their homes, and now, we need to come together as Floridians to deliver him a loss in his latest bid for the governor’s office.

The clock is ticking. Early Voting has already started. I need to know that I have your support heading into this final stretch of the campaign as I go head-to-head against the Democrat Machine.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=8e2662c866a0fd057c316ee8b427823431bc2d95709d85a800f831f24f9b9510b3e55bacd7593fccf79068fcf7a7ba9cf5d519eca26e6e2b
>>">Are you with me? Rush in your IMMEDIATE support now. >>>

For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

If 1,008 more donors contribute before Michael steps off the stage, we can show National Republicans that we won’t let them buy Colorado and our Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53291380/375026840/399325064?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221025_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZTcyNGU4ZC04MTU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vsmcMAjd3eNuLv5W66ZUJFEHO9uSipLuF6iSbgmPde8=)** I couldn’t be more proud of what Michael has accomplished for Coloradans. Now, he’s working to protect marriage equality and the right to choose under federal law. Tonight, Michael will defend that progress on stage. He’s known that this would be a tough race since the very beginning, and I know Coloradans will see exactly what I do: That we need Michael to keep fighting for us. Hi, friend. It's Val Demings.
I don't get downtime that often, but when I do, my husband, Jerry, and I like to go through our old photo albums. We laugh at the horribly out-of-style outfits, get teary at how little our three sons once were and take a moment to acknowledge where we started versus where we are now.

| | Nebraskans deserve a better and brighter future. They desire policies that put them first instead of policies that stand in their way. The Nebraska Republican Party supports a legislative plan building a path for a brighter tomorrow. We have full confidence in the potential of Nebraskans to create a future for themselves and their families filled with peace, prosperity, and opportunity. Below is one of the areas our 2023 Legislative Plan is focusing on. [GROW OUR NEBRASKA AGRICULTURAL INDUSTRY](https://www.ne.gop/so/1bOGEyTIn/c?w=bpf7iTTDtKSe92YeZxPv5l9laoR-cEP9ZBxBG0F--aQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmUuZ29wLzIwMjNsZWdpc2xhdGl2ZXBsYW4iLCJyIjoiYjM4ZmEyZTktYjk2NS00MTNiLWI4MDUtYzM1NmQ2OTczNWZjIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiNDE4YzE3NjEtZWRkMy00YzFhLWIwNjQtYzBiYWM5ZDAyNjRmIn0) Agri-business is vital to Nebraska’s economy and domestic ownership of our natural resources are a matter of national security. Ingenuity and Entrepreneurialism have transformed our Ag products into a “best in class” world recognized commodity.
* Strengthen the global demand for our agricultural products by reducing input costs

* Limit how many acres non-US foreign corporations may own and require annual reporting

We recognize agriculture in all its many facets, including farming, ranching, and agribusiness, as Nebraska’s primary industry and the cornerstone of its economy. We believe the agricultural economy must be consistently based in a market-oriented approach. We support the establishment of expanded markets as part of a fair and open global marketplace and recognize that maintaining such a marketplace can require the enforcement of restrictions and the creation of reasonable regulations for that purpose. We encourage incentives for new farmers and ranchers to help offset the dwindling number of Nebraska family farms and ranches. We encourage continuing research and development in agricultural products as well as the maintenance and support of research facilities.

| | With two weeks until Election Day, I wanted to share with you my economic platform. **This session, I voted for monumental steps to create jobs and make the economy work for everyone.** While we were experiencing some of the worst days of the pandemic, I voted for the American Rescue Plan, which included funds for COVID testing, small business recovery, and even direct payments to Americans. When it came time to take bold measures to create thousands of jobs and transform our economy, I helped draft and pass the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. And when so many people started feeling the pinch of inflation caused by corporate price gouging, I supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which places strict caps on the out-of-pocket costs for seniors on Medicare, allows Medicare to negotiate the price of prescription drugs, caps the price of insulin for seniors – and forces drug companies to give back money when their prices rise faster than inflation. I am proud to run on an economic platform that created jobs, lowered the cost of prescription drugs, and saved the economy from financial ruin. But with working families across Northwest Washington tightening their belts again, these are just the first steps Congress must take. clean_body: | | | | With two weeks until Election Day, I wanted to share with you my economic platform. This session, I voted for monumental steps to create jobs and make the economy work for everyone. While we were experiencing some of the worst days of the pandemic, I voted for the American Rescue Plan, which included funds for COVID testing, small business recovery, and even direct payments to Americans. When it came time to take bold measures to create thousands of jobs and transform our economy, I helped draft and pass the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. And when so many people started feeling the pinch of inflation caused by corporate price gouging, I supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which places strict caps on the out-of-pocket costs for seniors on Medicare, allows Medicare to negotiate the price of prescription drugs, caps the price of insulin for seniors – and forces drug companies to give back money when their prices rise faster than inflation. I am proud to run on an economic platform that created jobs, lowered the cost of prescription drugs, and saved the economy from financial ruin. But with working families across Northwest Washington tightening their belts again, these are just the first steps Congress must take. body:
| | | | |

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 25
GREATER GEORGIA RELEASES ANALYSIS OF HISTORIC EARLY VOTING TURNOUT
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia released an analysis of voter turnout for the first week of early voting for the 2022 midterm general election, running Monday, October 17th through Sunday, October 23rd. Compared to the same time period for the 2018 midterm general election, total turnout has increased by 74%, while early voting alone has increased by 90%. As of Sunday, over 830,000 Georgians cast their ballots by absentee voting or through early in-person voting.
"From the very first day of early voting, Georgians have come out in force to have a say in this year's midterm election - shattering turnout records with a level of enthusiasm we usually see only in presidential election years," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Turnout has increased 74%; every single demographic group has increased participation rates; over 13,000 voters have cast their ballots for the first time. Every piece of data so far has confirmed what we've known on the ground for months - not only that SB 202 has been a major positive for our state, but that the promise of strong conservative leadership is driving one of the most historic elections of our lifetimes."
See Greater Georgia analysis for the first week of early voting in the 2022 midterm general election compared to the same time period in the 2018 midterm general election below:
Total Turnout In total, 832,832 voters have cast their ballots so far in this year's general election - including 752,225 early voters and 80,607 absentee voters. This represents a 74% increase over 2018, when only 479,310 voters had cast their ballots in total.
Early In-Person Voting 752,225 Georgians have voted early so far this year, representing a 90% increase over 2018, when 396,292 voters had voted early in-person.
Absentee Voting So far, 247,531 Georgians have requested an absentee ballot, representing a 19% increase over 2018, when 207,816 voters requested an absentee ballot. 80,607 voters, or 33%, have returned their absentee ballots this year.
Disenfranchised Voters Of the 339,000 conservative voters who voted in the November 2020 general election but did not vote in the January 2021 runoff election, 27,568 have so far voted in the 2022 midterm general election.
First Time Voters 13,388 voters who have voted so far this year are first-time voters.
Voters by Gender A greater share of men are voting this year compared to 2018, though women continue to be the majority of voters. So far, 46% of voters are male and 54% are female, compared to 2018 when 45% of voters were male and 55% were female.
Compared to 2018, the participation rate of men increased by 74% and the participation rate of women increased by 73%.
Voters by Race A greater share of nonwhite voters are voting this year compared to 2018, though White voters continue to be the majority of voters. So far, 60% of voters are White, 34% are African American, 2% are Asian, and 1.8% are Hispanic. In 2018, 65% of voters where White, 31% were African American, 2% were Asian, and 1.6% were Hispanic.
Compared to 2018, the participation rate of White voters has increased by 62%, African American by 95%, Asian by 84%, and Hispanic by 89%.

clean_body: | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 25 GREATER GEORGIA RELEASES ANALYSIS OF HISTORIC EARLY VOTING TURNOUT (ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia released an analysis of voter turnout for the first week of early voting for the 2022 midterm general election, running Monday, October 17th through Sunday, October 23rd. Compared to the same time period for the 2018 midterm general election, total turnout has increased by 74%, while early voting alone has increased by 90%. As of Sunday, over 830,000 Georgians cast their ballots by absentee voting or through early in-person voting. "From the very first day of early voting, Georgians have come out in force to have a say in this year's midterm election - shattering turnout records with a level of enthusiasm we usually see only in presidential election years," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Turnout has increased 74%; every single demographic group has increased participation rates; over 13,000 voters have cast their ballots for the first time. Every piece of data so far has confirmed what we've known on the ground for months - not only that SB 202 has been a major positive for our state, but that the promise of strong conservative leadership is driving one of the most historic elections of our lifetimes." See Greater Georgia analysis for the first week of early voting in the 2022 midterm general election compared to the same time period in the 2018 midterm general election below: Total Turnout In total, 832,832 voters have cast their ballots so far in this year's general election - including 752,225 early voters and 80,607 absentee voters. This represents a 74% increase over 2018, when only 479,310 voters had cast their ballots in total. Early In-Person Voting 752,225 Georgians have voted early so far this year, representing a 90% increase over 2018, when 396,292 voters had voted early in-person. Absentee Voting So far, 247,531 Georgians have requested an absentee ballot, representing a 19% increase over 2018, when 207,816 voters requested an absentee ballot. 80,607 voters, or 33%, have returned their absentee ballots this year. Disenfranchised Voters Of the 339,000 conservative voters who voted in the November 2020 general election but did not vote in the January 2021 runoff election, 27,568 have so far voted in the 2022 midterm general election. First Time Voters 13,388 voters who have voted so far this year are first-time voters. Voters by Gender A greater share of men are voting this year compared to 2018, though women continue to be the majority of voters. So far, 46% of voters are male and 54% are female, compared to 2018 when 45% of voters were male and 55% were female. Compared to 2018, the participation rate of men increased by 74% and the participation rate of women increased by 73%. Voters by Race A greater share of nonwhite voters are voting this year compared to 2018, though White voters continue to be the majority of voters. So far, 60% of voters are White, 34% are African American, 2% are Asian, and 1.8% are Hispanic. In 2018, 65% of voters where White, 31% were African American, 2% were Asian, and 1.6% were Hispanic. My opponents, Maura Healey and Kim Driscoll, are simply on the wrong side of this issue and they do not have the best interests of the people of Massachusetts at heart.
As we've been saying all along... On Day One, Leah Allen and I will rehire every state worker who lost their job due to vaccine mandates, and on Day Two we're going to terminate any bureaucrat who thought those vaccine mandates were a good idea!

name: Martin Sheen
subject: the most important Senate race in the country
body:
Hi Derek,
I know you've heard from a lot of people about how Catherine Cortez Masto's (D-NV) Senate race is the most important in the country – but with 14 days until the election, I wanted you to hear it from me, too.
While you might associate me with my roles as an actor – particularly a former (fictional) president – I speak to you today as a concerned fellow American: If Catherine Cortez Masto loses in Nevada, we hand over control of the Senate to Mitch McConnell, and worse still, pave the way for a second Trump era.
I am going to do everything in my power to make sure that doesn't happen, which is why I'm emailing. Will you help Catherine keep Nevada and the Senate blue by helping her reach her $50,000 goal before midnight by splitting a $25 donation between her campaign and CommonGood? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221025_CGVA_CCM]
You know as well as I do why we can't let that happen. The last time Republicans controlled our democratic institutions – headed by McConnell and the impeached former president – was marked by deception, selfishness and every hindrance of progress possible. This period culminated in an attack on democracy itself, sanctioned by many of those who could be part of the Senate majority if Sen. Cortez Masto loses this seat.
The darkness of those years should serve as a reminder for why our Democratic majority is so crucial – but the hopefulness of recent days should be our clarion call. Sen. Cortez Masto and her Democratic colleagues have helmed historic action on infrastructure, climate change, and lowering prescription drug prices. They confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court. And so much more.
With hope and hard work, we've accomplished a great deal. But with Sen. Cortez Masto down 1 point in the polls and up against more than $55 million in GOP attacks, she needs our help to win.
Let's help Catherine raise $50,000 before her midnight fundraising deadline. Split a donation of $25 or whatever you can spare to the most important Senate race in the country to save our Democratic majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221025_CGVA_CCM]
I've been an activist most of my life, Derek. I've witnessed our nation confront and overcome a host of consequential challenges. And I've learned that, at such critical junctures of history, we must ask ourselves: Who do we want to be as a country?
Do we want to be a country where the very right to bodily autonomy lies in the hands of right-wing extremists? The kind of country where health care and lifesaving medications are so expensive, they are out of reach for countless Americans? The kind of country where outright lies and conspiracies are used to tear down our democracy?
I say no . No to the country that MAGA Republican rule would manifest. No to extremism and attacks on democracy and fundamental rights. But – and I say this with no exaggeration – this all rides on whether Catherine Cortez Masto wins this battleground Senate race in Nevada.
Experts from The New York Times to CNN are reporting Catherine is the most vulnerable Democratic senator on the ballot, so we urgently need to do our part to help her win. Will you please split $25 or whatever you can spare today between Catherine Cortez Masto and CommonGood to save our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221025_CGVA_CCM]
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know my team and I have been reaching out a lot more recently, but that's only because we have less than two weeks until Election Day and we're running out of time.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "2")
---
I've told you before about my humble beginnings; my father was a bartender and my mother was a maid. This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Together, they were able to realize the American Dream and give my siblings and me a chance for a better life. I wanted to take a moment today to share with you how I've taken the work ethic my parents instilled in me to serve America.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "1")
---

This is a photo of me when I was a representative in the Florida State House - many years and a few gray hairs ago. It was there I found my passion for serving others. I served there for nearly 9 years and was proud to be a voice for my constituents.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "3")
---

Eventually, I chose to run for Senate. I won the Republican nomination and was sworn into the U.S. Senate in 2011. In my first term, I worked with fellow Republicans to stop the Obama Administration's abuse of power. In my second term, I wrote policies to support hard-working families, like doubling the child tax credit, enabling veterans to access the healthcare they deserve, and supporting small businesses during COVID-19.

In 2016, after seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "4")
---

Throughout his term, President Trump and I worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

This brings me to my main point: **I 'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting for AMERICA. **

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

**Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is REAL. I can 't continue to fight for your bottom line if I lose to a Pelosi Puppet on November 8. [I'm humbly asking you to chip in whatever you can - $25, 50, $75 or even $100 - so I have the resources to fight back against my radical opponent and win this race.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "I’m humbly asking you to chip in whatever you can – $6, 15, $38 or even $75
– so I have the resources to fight back against my radical opponent and win this race.")**
---
| | | [HELP MARCO KEEP FIGHTING FOR YOU!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "HELP
MARCO KEEP FIGHTING FOR YOU!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Peter. I'm really grateful to have you on my team.

- Marco Rubio (R-FL)

**P.S.** My opponent outraised me for a sixth quarter in a row, this time by $13 MILLION. **[Even if it's just $25, can you please chip in to help me stand up to her warchest of cash?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730466:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "Even if it’s just $1, can you please chip in to help me stand up to her warchest of
cash?")**
---
| | | | |

* * *
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730467:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "POLLS TIED!") I'm not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 20 days from the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls.

I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. Far-Left progressive groups are pouring in millions of dollars to try to win this Senate seat. The truth is, **I will lose if I don 't have your support.**

Please, Peter, I'm begging: **[Will you chip in right now?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730467:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "Will you chip
in right now?")** | | [SEND IMMEDIATE HELP](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730467:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "SEND IMMEDIATE HELP")
---
|

| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730468:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "Countdown to Election Day")
---

Hey it's Marco and I just checked my watch - **we 're running out of time.**

I just don't know what to do. I keep asking myself, _" Is it even worth reaching out to them again?"_

I know you get a lot of these, and I know it can be overwhelming looking at all the requests. But if you respond to just 1 today, please, make it this one. I am being outraised 3 to 1, and polls are tied. They're saying this may be my closest race yet. **They 're saying I'm in the fight of my life.**

So, I'm humbly coming to you - hat in hand - asking one last time: **[Will you please send in just $25 to help me get our country back on track and prospering again?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61730469:6MnnljGfN:m:1:3365131770:12C8606E4B0BC1B014BD246B57466EE9:r "Will you please send in just $17 to help me get our country back on track and prospering

body:
I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is.
#

Friends —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. **But I refuse to let them win.**
I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — [**will you donate $3 if you agree?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct22.7U3p1A&refcode=em221025-1-7&t=1&akid=4462%2E6688874%2EYJQFcm)
I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — [**if you agree, will you donate $3?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct22.7U3p1A&refcode=em221025-1-7&t=2&akid=4462%2E6688874%2EYJQFcm)
Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.
[**I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is. Chip in $3 today if you’re ready to help me win re-election and defend our majority >>**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct22.7U3p1A&refcode=em221025-1-7&t=3&akid=4462%2E6688874%2EYJQFcm)

And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same. In just 14 days we must get Bob Good, Yesli Vega, and the rest of our congressional delegation across the finish line. I recommend you and your friends vote today or as early as possible.
I'm running for State Senate so we can un-California Virginia. It starts with election integrity. For a better future, we must win back the Virginia State Senate in 2023 and stop the madness. body:
I am honored to receive the endorsement of Andy Colaninno | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/796f6c80344c/test-email-meet-mike-ford-the-democrat-running-in-ga-1289?e=e60663a86e)
---
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=251f953011&e=e60663a86e)
# Mike Ford, the Democrat Running for
US Congress in GA-09
US Army Vietnam Veteran. Lawyer for 46 years. Husband, father, grandfather.
Dedicated to defend the US Constitution, our rights, and our freedoms.
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=eaa79e228f&e=e60663a86e)
**I am honored to have the official endorsement of my good friend and mentor, Andy Colaninno.****Where to start with my dear friend Andrew “Andy” Colaninno?** I count myself very lucky in life to have Andy as a friend for so many years. We met when I became active with the Hall County Democratic Committee as Andy was already mainstay with the Hall County Democrats. My wife, Jeri, and I got to know Andy and his wife, Laura, and we all became very good friends.What I’ve learned from Andy over the years is more than I can share. Andy’s determination to know and understand the truth, his ceaseless quest for clarity in politics and his determination to protect our democracy are all legendary – and are the essential Andy. I’ve always been impressed with his devotion to just being a good, thoughtful person and citizen. **What I’ve learned from Andy since his recent Stage 4 Pancreatic Cancer diagnosis has been the ultimate life lesson in bravery, courage, and strength.** A forester by training and long time service with the US Forest Service, Andy always shares a full appreciation for our world and environment – and how we are screwing it up. People often underestimate Andy’s intellect and scope of knowledge which we find amusing. Andy is my rock in politics. When I think I may be screwing up, he helps me achieve clarity. Andy served as mentor, helper, and treasurer to my campaign. He and Laura make a formidable team for political action.

Andrew Colaninno is a good, solid man in a universe of mediocrity – and my very good friend. His endorsement means the world to me, and I will do my best to honor his support. Andy officially endorses the following Democratic candidates running for elected office in Hall County:

**Mike Ford** for US Congress GA-09
**Jody Cooley** for Georgia State Senate District 49
**Devin Pandy** for Georgia State House District 29
**Kim Floria** for Georgia State House District 30
**Angela Thomas Middleton** for Hall County Board of Education Post 1
**Pat Calmes** for Hall County Board of Education At-Large
**Isabel Martinez Flynn** for Hall County Board of Education Post 2
**Laura AE Colaninno** for Hall County Commissioner District 1With Sincere Gratitude,
Mike Ford
[**mike4georgia.com**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=971b797945&e=e60663a86e)
|
---
**Since Andy is Dressing as FDR for Halloween, A Few Words About Saving Social Security ****For over 87 years, Social Security has been one of the most successful, most popular, most effective, most enduring Government programs ever implemented.** Democratic President, Franklin D. Roosevelt, FDR, passed Social Security in 1935 and it has benefited generations of Americans. For 87 years Social Security has been a lifeline for millions of seniors, disabled people, widows, widowers and their children. Unfortunately, since inception, Republicans have been trying for 87 years to undermine, privatize, cut, gut, dismantle, and flat out destroy Social Security. Their attacks continue today as multiple Republicans in both the House and Senate have publicly announced their intent to gut and dismantle Social Security if and when they get control of Congress. We can't let that happen.**Social Security is not an "entitlement", it’s an earned benefit** that you paid into over the course of your career and the money is yours to receive back starting in your 60's. Social Security payments are the return of deferred compensation that we all paid into and entrusted the Government to make repayment back to us during our retirement years. That is the guarantee that the government must honor. Monthly Social Security payments are a financial life-line for many seniors, retirees, widows/widowers and their children, and disabled Americans, regardless of their political affiliation. When I'm in Congress, I will work with Democrats to shore up and strengthen Social Security so all workers, no matter if you are in your 20's, 30's, 40's, 50's, will have the peace of mind that your earned Social Security benefits will be there for you when you reach your 60's.**I could go on at length about Social Security** because it's such a great program, but I will close with this, never, and I mean never, trust Republicans to manage your Social Security benefits. Moreover, when Republican leaders have plainly and publicly told Americans that they plan to "sunset" Social Security, they plan to raise the age to receive your benefits, they plan to slash benefits, believe them. Republicans will not honor the Government’s guarantee of Social Security.**It’s time to vote out Republicans, not just in GA-09 but in every district.**
|
---
**On Your Mark. Get Set. Go Vote!****Early voting is happening in Georgia right now through November 4th!** You never know if bad weather, car trouble, or a family/work emergency will prevent you from voting on Election Day so don’t delay, please vote early. **Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 8.** Democracy is not a spectator sport, as citizens of the United States of America, it is our civic duty to vote and to help others vote. To preview your full ballot of all candidates + ballot initiatives, simply go to [**www.ballotpedia.org**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=0b0ec86bc7&e=e60663a86e) click on “2022 Elections” then click on “Preview My Ballot” then enter your address. When voting, don’t stop at the top, vote blue the entire ballot.
|
---
**You’re Invited to a Meet-and-Greet in Suwanee, GA****Thank you to all the folks who have registered so far! This is shaping up to be a great event.** Join Mike Ford, Josh Uddin, Louisa Shell Jackson and other candidates for a free Meet-and-Greet event this Thursday, Oct 27th in Suwanee. You don’t have to live in Suwanee or even in Gwinnett County to join us. Everyone is welcome!Simply click the photo or the link below to learn more + RSVP.

People often underestimate Andy’s intellect and scope of knowledge which we find amusing. Andy is my rock in politics. When I think I may be screwing up, he helps me achieve clarity. Andy served as mentor, helper, and treasurer to my campaign. He and Laura make a formidable team for political action. Andrew Colaninno is a good, solid man in a universe of mediocrity – and my very good friend. His endorsement means the world to me, and I will do my best to honor his support. Andy officially endorses the following Democratic candidates running for elected office in Hall County: Mike Ford for US Congress GA-09 Jody Cooley for Georgia State Senate District 49 Devin Pandy for Georgia State House District 29 Kim Floria for Georgia State House District 30 Angela Thomas Middleton for Hall County Board of Education Post 1 Pat Calmes for Hall County Board of Education At-Large Isabel Martinez Flynn for Hall County Board of Education Post 2 Laura AE Colaninno for Hall County Commissioner District 1With Sincere Gratitude, Mike Ford | Since Andy is Dressing as FDR for Halloween, A Few Words About Saving Social Security For over 87 years, Social Security has been one of the most successful, most popular, most effective, most enduring Government programs ever implemented. Democratic President, Franklin D. Roosevelt, FDR, passed Social Security in 1935 and it has benefited generations of Americans. For 87 years Social Security has been a lifeline for millions of seniors, disabled people, widows, widowers and their children. Unfortunately, since inception, Republicans have been trying for 87 years to undermine, privatize, cut, gut, dismantle, and flat out destroy Social Security. Their attacks continue today as multiple Republicans in both the House and Senate have publicly announced their intent to gut and dismantle Social Security if and when they get control of Congress. We can't let that happen.Social Security is not an "entitlement", it’s an earned benefit that you paid into over the course of your career and the money is yours to receive back starting in your 60's. Social Security payments are the return of deferred compensation that we all paid into and entrusted the Government to make repayment back to us during our retirement years. That is the guarantee that the government must honor. Monthly Social Security payments are a financial life-line for many seniors, retirees, widows/widowers and their children, and disabled Americans, regardless of their political affiliation. When I'm in Congress, I will work with Democrats to shore up and strengthen Social Security so all workers, no matter if you are in your 20's, 30's, 40's, 50's, will have the peace of mind that your earned Social Security benefits will be there for you when you reach your 60's.I could go on at length about Social Security because it's such a great program, but I will close with this, never, and I mean never, trust Republicans to manage your Social Security benefits. Moreover, when Republican leaders have plainly and publicly told Americans that they plan to "sunset" Social Security, they plan to raise the age to receive your benefits, they plan to slash benefits, believe them. Republicans will not honor the Government’s guarantee of Social Security.It’s time to vote out Republicans, not just in GA-09 but in every district. | On Your Mark. Get Set. You never know if bad weather, car trouble, or a family/work emergency will prevent you from voting on Election Day so don’t delay, please vote early. Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 8. Democracy is not a spectator sport, as citizens of the United States of America, it is our civic duty to vote and to help others vote. To preview your full ballot of all candidates + ballot initiatives, simply go to click on “2022 Elections” then click on “Preview My Ballot” then enter your address. Only 22 donations were received by my campaign yesterday. We're not going to win this "Tossup" race if this continues into the weekend. The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=34a64268cc6b468788329fcbfff847df&_e=v9FcEcZars6kBvEL-XMGIPklHoCwXuGjxRF0l2hRq_nrHtedq-2fc511S4U-wrCRCEDBMcEGIuoA6Y1T8RCJ4LAtfi_TR1Ac64mbxXY8T9PZKTS5PPpJC4-Qh6AO9y6RHNoT6p3RqTCclJjnus5xFt3EfS4lb3vTJtKZ4WAlTdEguldV9chqG_ukkQ7p42J_CuCVHa8vR4oMhA6AqVK9Fy_m47K8dHOMhm0AHDazzZNf30nEypOYOYU2hMVEDJyjFjK3QHKMoMliafKqpq_tWMbq476oUTFbaFISfAbt4NEOT_tbShlrpR_MJtyHnNo-9WJimD4mTmbxm0GIqJErDRkzLg2E4-JyTgbq4RhtI0uhxF9TMUnkqXyySB0-EFmX)
---
Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038– more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day’s end._**

| October 25, 2022
---
| | Friends,

Welcome back to another _**Russell's Roundup**_ , your weekly source for the latest on Russell Fry's campaign to Congress to take back the House!

---
|
---
| [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=bbd9e196e4&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**#RussellontheRoad** Last week I had the incredible experience of traveling to five states in four days to stump for ten candidates running for Congress to help retake the majority and remove Democrats from power.

The theme from voters in Arizona, New Mexico, Kansas, Iowa, and North Carolina is the same as it is here in South Carolina. In just two years, Democrats have managed to screw things up in the most catastrophic way possible. Their politics have led to some of the worst economic numbers we've seen in decades. It's time to sweep them out of power and restore some sanity in Washington!
|
---
| [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=a95f956478&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**EARLY VOTING HAS STARTED IN SOUTH CAROLINA**
We're not going to win this race without YOU. Head to the polls now through November 5 to vote early in this year's election. Bring friends, remind your neighbor, call your family, and make sure they all have a plan to vote.

We must elect strong conservatives up and down the ballot and turn this Red Wave into a Red Tsunami in South Carolina and across the country. I would be honored to have your vote to be a part of the new Republican majority that takes back Congress and puts Nancy Pelosi out of a job.

For additional information on how to vote in SC, head to [https://scvotes.gov/voters/early-voting/](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=801f2309cb&e=7aa6ac5965).
|

---

**USC Gamecock Tailgate**
We had such a great time at the tailgate on Saturday before the USC game — and the Gamecock's win against Texas A&M made it even better!

It was great to see everyone there! Thanks to my special guests, Congressman Norman and Wilson, for popping by to say hello.
---
|
---
---
| | **WE NEED YOU! **
This election isn't going to win itself. We need everything you can give to dethrone the Democrats! Click [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=c7feafc8c1&e=7aa6ac5965) to donate.

**Pssst! PASS IT ON!**
Help spread the word of what Russell is doing here in the 7th Congressional District. Please take a moment and forward this newsletter to 10 of your neighbors, relatives, co-workers, and friends. They’ll be glad you did!

**COUNTDOWN TO ELECTION DAY!**
There are just **_14_ **days — TWO WEEKS— until November 8. Mark your calendars and get ready to head to the polls!
