Team,

As one of the only southwestern states that still protects legal abortion access, New Mexico has become the epicenter of post-Roe America. **That is why I joined Vice President Kamala Harris today at the University of New Mexico to rally for reproductive rights.**

VP Harris is here because she wants to engage with state leaders who put the rights of its citizens, especially women, first.

body:
We are amazingly fortunate to have a true public servant as our nominee in Cheri Beasley.
#

Hi, it’s James Taylor.
I’m reaching out about my friend and the woman I hope will be North Carolina’s next Senator, Cheri Beasley.
We are amazingly fortunate to have a true public servant as our nominee in Cheri Beasley. She understands the concept of putting people first. Public service has been her life's commitment – from public defender to the first Black woman to serve as Chief Justice of the NC Supreme Court.
She understands that it’s our next Senator's job to be a voice for every single Tar Heel, not just the ones who vote for her. On top of that, she would be North Carolina’s first Black Senator and the only Black woman in the U.S. Senate.
There’s so much that needs to change in our country. We need to defend abortion rights, save our planet, protect the right to vote and our democracy, and level the playing field for the working class.
In a time of deep division, North Carolina can own that change, but we must get involved. So I am asking you to join me:
If you are ready for new leadership in North Carolina, [**will you please chip in to power Cheri Beasley’s campaign to victory? With two weeks until Election Day, and with so much at stake, we just have to stick together and do the work.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221025-1-T1&t=1&akid=2115%2E357359%2ESHjt7b)

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The next 2 weeks: by the numbers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221025&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221025&amount=28]
Team,
Somehow – there are only two weeks left until Election Day. We’re really getting down to the wire, so I thought I’d break down the next 14 days by the numbers.
For a quick recap, I’m running in the brand new 7th district. It’s quite a bit bigger than the district I currently represent. To be specific, we added 3 new counties, 28,382 more people, and 1,310 more square miles. That has meant pulling off an aggressive strategy to meet as many new people as we possibly can.
At this point in the campaign, nearly all of our resources (that aren’t going into advertising) are going into our field program. To date, we’ve made 492,473 phone calls, sent 533,367 text messages, knocked on 53,820 doors, distributed 3,200 yard signs, and held 24 town hall style events. Our main focus is getting in touch with our supporters and seeing if they’ve already turned in their ballots. If they haven’t, by the time the conversation is over we make sure they have a concrete plan to make their voices heard.
In addition to our normal field program, we have our Michigan State University program. This has been solely focused on helping students at MSU get registered and making sure they have a plan to vote. We have 232 paid student organizers on campus helping us make that happen by talking to their peers in high traffic areas around campus, at football games, and in their actual dorms. We’re always hiring, so if you know any MSU students that might be interested in helping us out, send them to https://forms.gle/2n5FEVXDUg6Q6mLC9
Our other primary focus of the next two weeks: advertising. We have released 9 total TV ads so far this election, and counting. You can watch them all here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] . Getting my message in front of voters that I haven’t been able to meet yet in the new district has been critical, as they have been bombarded with negative ads from dark money super PACs about me for months.
Unfortunately, this is THE most expensive House race in the country. So far, nearly $8.5 million has been spent against me by these dark money super PACs, with another $1.5 million reserved in TV against me for the final week of the campaign alone. An insane amount that has already surpassed the spending we saw in 2020.
We’ve got a lot of work to do over the next 14 days. I know it’s felt like this election has lasted a lifetime – but if you can just hang in there with me for the next two weeks, I promise life will return to normal. And, if you want to help us finish out the next 14 days strong, consider chipping in below. In one of the most competitive House races in the country, every dollar counts! subject: 2022 will be the most important year in the history of our Republic

body:
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take.
| | |

Friends –

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with $55 million in attack ads. With just 14 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.
**[So I'm asking you now, friend: will you help meet this moment by pitching in to Maggie Hassan's reelection campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53286107/375005623/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1929-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDkwMTM3ZC03ODU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o1lrFdQIj4oGVAqvNZnbc4OrTqh3f-yxYP8Eg64zhjE=)**

clean_body: Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. | | | Friends – I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy. From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens. Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it." That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire. Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers. Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future. Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with $55 million in attack ads. With just 14 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote. = With Washington divided, I believe that Maggie is the person we need to help bridge the gulf between the two parties, wider now and more divisive than I have ever seen. It's incumbent on us to redouble our efforts and dig a little deeper to ensure that Maggie has the support she needs to be reelected. = Thank you, Ken | | = | If you'd like to support Maggie Hassan for Senate, =. = If you’re reading this from your phone, to automatically sign up for our SMS list. Hi, it's Tulsi Gabbard, former Democratic Congresswoman and former Vice Chair of the Democratic National Committee.
I recently left the Democratic Party because it's under the complete control of an elitist cabal of warmongers driven by cowardly "wokeness." | | | | [DEFEAT WOKENESS](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61731536:68IiVjGNg:m:1:3346849603:52B744B40DB60CC38E9385AF4C4DF320:r)

Democrats have gone insane with ideological fanaticism, and to put it plainly, the Democratic Party that I joined doesn't exist anymore.

| Peter,
I recently joined Tucker Carlson and the buzz around my campaign has continued to gain tremendous momentum. I'm taking time from my busy schedule campaigning to write you this email, so even if you don't send a gift, I'd really appreciate it if you'd read it in its entirety.
**[If you'd like to make a donation to continue my campaign's momentum, you can do so here.](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJxNkE2KwzAMhU_T7GQsS_5bZNHN3EOxlTY0zYTaZZjbj7sbEEhPPD6epDOGECIy5jzV2RYrXKft39amjDlRZOMsRpMchyFdyIHG7HOmC9vtBIwOCMEzOG_eDVRaB2fK9_N8dzXb0fV1yD7dZxkgynnVSAljkFq9r4sjDX4pUXna53vvZ7vQ9eK-RvWXlId5yrZD-21dn6bpUZvc9IMfhn07HqPZZAcqJbASCDjwCtnLCuRLDOQ8ES7Dhig1FU7AUSpwdRkWSRYwOdVxFa-2DFsNXLUWhuKLB042gWRBWKLViMScZZ1ecz1_tn3fWojjD7dPyE-oP0DaX3I)**
We covered a number of topics that I think every voter in PA should know about.
**The Establishment turning their back on a 30 year Army veteran.** I served our country honorably and led some of the best young men our nation has to offer, yet when I announced for Governor the political Establishment on both sides shunned me... it must mean I'm speaking the hard truths, but as our second President John Adams famously said "facts are stubborn things." The political Establishment in our country is failing Republicans, Democrats, and everyone in between, and I'll never bow to their go-along get-along agenda. They doubted me in the primary, but with the backing of the grassroots and patriots in Pennsylvania and across our country, I proved them wrong, and I'm going to do it again on November 8th.
**Unleashing Pennsylvania 's oil and gas reserves to jumpstart our economy on Day 1 of a Mastriano administration.** The answer to many of our economic woes is unleashing American energy dominance, and as Governor of Pennsylvania, on Day 1, I'll have the power to open up drilling and fracking at a scale never seen before in our nation's history. Joe Biden's war on American energy got us into this mess, and Pennsylvania will be where the American energy comeback begins. | | | | [DONATE](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJxNkE2KwzAMhU_T7GQsS_5bZNHN3EOxlTY0zYTaZZjbj7sbEEhPPD6epDOGECIy5jzV2RYrXKft39amjDlRZOMsRpMchyFdyIHG7HOmC9vtBIwOCMEzOG_eDVRaB2fK9_N8dzXb0fV1yD7dZxkgynnVSAljkFq9r4sjDX4pUXna53vvZ7vQ9eK-RvWXlId5yrZD-21dn6bpUZvc9IMfhn07HqPZZAcqJbASCDjwCtnLCuRLDOQ8ES7Dhig1FU7AUSpwdRkWSRYwOdVxFa-2DFsNXLUWhuKLB042gWRBWKLViMScZZ1ecz1_tn3fWojjD7dPyE-oP0DaX3I)
---
**Josh Shapiro 's record of failure when it comes to violent crime.**
Unlike Josh Shapiro, I've served in war zones, and right now Philadelphia looks more like a war zone than the city where American Democracy was born. Crime has gone up 40% since Shapiro took power as Attorney General. Videos have surfaced online showing bands of criminals with illegal automatic weapons hopping out of vans at gas stations in Philadelphia and stealing cars of innocent citizens. There's one place criminals like that will be under a Mastriano Administration, the state penitentiary, where they will be serving maximum sentences.

**There are 12 Pennsylvanian 's dying everyday from Fentynal.**
Biden's open border has drugs flowing into our country freely and it's causing a drug epidemic in Pennsylvania. Dealers and traffickers of these lethal drugs will be in the same place as the criminals sticking up drivers at gunpoint, the penitentiary.

At the end of our interview, Tucker came to the same conclusion that everyone who knows me can testify to, I'm not a radical, I'm just a guy who loves his country and his state too much to let it be destroyed by the woke left. I could have ridden off into the sunset for a comfortable retirement with the love of my life, my wife Rebbie, but instead I'm here, fighting for you and your family. **[I'd be proud to call you a donor to my campaign if you're in a position to give.](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJxNkE2KwzAMhU_T7GQsS_5bZNHN3EOxlTY0zYTaZZjbj7sbEEhPPD6epDOGECIy5jzV2RYrXKft39amjDlRZOMsRpMchyFdyIHG7HOmC9vtBIwOCMEzOG_eDVRaB2fK9_N8dzXb0fV1yD7dZxkgynnVSAljkFq9r4sjDX4pUXna53vvZ7vQ9eK-RvWXlId5yrZD-21dn6bpUZvc9IMfhn07HqPZZAcqJbASCDjwCtnLCuRLDOQ8ES7Dhig1FU7AUSpwdRkWSRYwOdVxFa-2DFsNXLUWhuKLB042gWRBWKLViMScZZ1ecz1_tn3fWojjD7dPyE-oP0DaX3I)**

After 30 years in uniform serving our country, I know one thing, the fight to save our country is worth fighting. Nothing on earth has ever come close to the greatness of the promise of the American Dream, and I'm doing everything in my power to preserve it. I'd be honored if you joined me.

body:
The Left is desperate to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, so they came up with an “October Surprise.” We cannot let the Le |
---
Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=fc4696e024fa4c959716839aa01cb3e5&_e=X8jac00WpLblaOfuA5-IS-nQxXlU9LmgWYuPHMN3QDIPncOhyzMj3oFQzelLZBFCnrq0bzf0-T1o5GqBoaHmowLxQzKrPPADTVA15HaeBhQIyPqmPsN9aLDu_WT-JN6eb-8Bzq6AvKa_TrX4I2nQ81bO-bvNPAIHJtkg21WpkjTXwFX-PNl1Tv6s5OrtLHLli1kwJ1N5aNe_hOoRJK36nnpTT2GD9KF75LIeVzGAInjQs0P9iX7mDABpUtida7npCXwLnAnfaZIOzh2y0CqtK4moxeohB_Fd7BqOpCMDShfpzylnZ6BRT-SecewkC5ud8gcOU1TllKKeqiI3Ia65EEUmKlNh1ZU2EI0Nsxg7aIcwwp1-bx9M2CP8hTUauyEsMrGg7O0ZnRu_c35pDD67Vw%3D%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

**[I need your help and support now more than ever. Will you please stand with me?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=fc4696e024fa4c959716839aa01cb3e5&_e=X8jac00WpLblaOfuA5-IS-nQxXlU9LmgWYuPHMN3QDIPncOhyzMj3oFQzelLZBFCnrq0bzf0-T1o5GqBoaHmowLxQzKrPPADTVA15HaeBhQIyPqmPsN9aLDu_WT-JN6eb-8Bzq6AvKa_TrX4I2nQ81bO-bvNPAIHJtkg21WpkjTXwFX-PNl1Tv6s5OrtLHLli1kwJ1N5aNe_hOoRJK36nnpTT2GD9KF75LIeVzGAInjQs0P9iX7mDABpUtida7npF0AVbsaGcwjI6adhSkULB7t27-JH-fy4HF-gfFlPWxjx-uQ8zEbLJiXnstvbJKKd0_osb5WW1sVwL2mQJGCpI7-YQSOlT5fGRcX-qUAXBOPkPzXJpjGcgw8aPZYW7slLgeaHqsEPZzJj51AlWgtKJA%3D%3D)**

Unfortunately, that's politics these days. I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. The time is now

Friend,

There isn't much time left, so I'll make this quick.

Early voting has started in Georgia, and we've already seen record turnout.

If far-Left Democrat Raphael Warnock wins this race again, there will be dire consequences for Georgia and our country. He's bad on crime, bad for our economy, and bad for our schools.

When I'm elected, I'll secure our border, make America energy independent again, defend our police instead of defunding them, cut spending to reduce inflation, and get our country back on track.

**_[I can't do this alone, so I'm asking you to step up today to help me and other strong conservatives win our elections.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvvsa6md3cgn6h837i6dmfmddrvg86nku0ds5rt0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cth61pr0chh2bs "I can’t do this alone, so I’m asking you to step up today to help me and other strong conservatives win our elections.")_**

---
All eyes are on Georgia. If Republicans win here, Democrats have virtually no chance of holding on to their majority.

The latest polls show Senator Warnock and I are neck and neck, so I know we can win.

This race will come down to the final get-out-the-vote efforts. Every single dollar could impact how many more doors we can knock, phone calls we can make, texts we can send, and voters we can reach.

So can I please count on you to pitch in anything you're able ASAP, even if it's just $3?

Thank you in advance for your generous support.

Sincerely,

Herschel Walker

subject: early voting in Wisconsin starts today, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
This is a pivotal moment for our campaign, and we don't get another chance at this.
| | |
---
Hi friend, it's Mandela. I'm reaching out to ask you to do something important with early voting beginning in Wisconsin today.
This U.S. Senate race is going to be one of the closest races in the whole country. A CNN poll that came out _yesterday_ shows us trailing by one point, and Cook Political rates us as a toss-up.
**So our job right now, with early voting now open, is to reach the voters that will decide the outcome of this race. We know which people we need to persuade and mobilize in order to win, but whether or not they vote in this election is up to us. **
This is a pivotal moment for our campaign, and we don't get another chance at this. It will take a lot of time, energy, and resources in order to turn out voters across Wisconsin, and today I need to ask for your help.

Radical leftist teachers and school districts have gone too far. First, they tried shoving Critical Race Theory and transgender propaganda down our throats. Why? Because Shawn had the audacity to question the public school’s curriculum and speak out against radical school board members. You see, Shawn filed a series of public record requests (FOAA) and complaints about the conduct of school personnel. ** ** **However, instead of investigating the issues that Shawn was pointing out, the school district filed a lawsuit against Shawn, seeking to silence him and prevent him from ever filing FOAA requests ever again.** And on top of that, the school district informed him that he was not allowed to attend any of his daughter’s graduation events. My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm the Founder of the Center for American Liberty and I've dedicated my career to preserving Constitutional liberties like the freedom of speech which are constantly under attack by the radical left. The Constitution clearly protects your ability to criticize public officials and government employees. It doesn’t matter if it’s the President of the United States or a school board member in your community – no one is above criticism. clean_body: | | | Friend, Radical leftist teachers and school districts have gone too far. First, they tried shoving Critical Race Theory and transgender propaganda down our throats. Then, they began holding secret “equality clubs” and convinced children that they might be bisexual or transgender without telling their parents. Now, they’re doing everything in their power to completely silence and censor anyone who fights back. In fact, they’re even BANNING parents from attending their own children’s graduation ceremonies if they disagree with the woke curriculum being taught. I’m happy to announce that we’re taking legal action to fight back, but we need your help urgently. Shawn McBreairty is the father of a high school senior in Bangor, Maine who was told that he was not allowed to attend his daughter’s graduation ceremony. Why? Because Shawn had the audacity to question the public school’s curriculum and speak out against radical school board members. You see, Shawn filed a series of public record requests (FOAA) and complaints about the conduct of school personnel. However, instead of investigating the issues that Shawn was pointing out, the school district filed a lawsuit against Shawn, seeking to silence him and prevent him from ever filing FOAA requests ever again. And on top of that, the school district informed him that he was not allowed to attend any of his daughter’s graduation events. But Shawn hasn’t given up – in fact, he’s now working with my team to take the fight to the next level. We’ve filed an Anti-SLAPP motion to dismiss the ridiculous lawsuit against Shawn—because Shawn’s speech is CLEARLY protected by the First Amendment. We’re fighting hard, but we can’t do it without you. Let me take a moment to introduce myself. My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm the Founder of the Center for American Liberty and I've dedicated my career to preserving Constitutional liberties like the freedom of speech which are constantly under attack by the radical left. The Constitution clearly protects your ability to criticize public officials and government employees. It doesn’t matter if it’s the President of the United States or a school board member in your community – no one is above criticism. You and I cannot allow school districts like the Herman School Department in Bangor, Maine, to get away with censoring parents. Enough is enough. It’s time for all of us to stand with parents like Shawn and let these radical schools know that they will no longer be allowed to silence us or corrupt our kids. There’s no time to waste. Thank you in advance for your support. Onward to victory, | | Harmeet K. Dhillon | | | P.S. One of the FOAA requests that Shawn filed asked specifically about controversial training that a teacher provided to various schools in the area – that request was denied. We’ve been hard at work for almost a year now — meeting voters where they are, proving Josh will be a Governor folks can count on, and explaining just how high the stakes are this election.

Derek — we are just 14 days — that’s just two weeks — away from Election Day. This team has been working for over a year now to meet Pennsylvanians from all walks of life, getting out my message of taking on the big fights, and laying out everything that’s on the line in this election. That’s taken a lot of hard work from this team — but we still have a big challenge ahead of us to make sure that we win on November 8 in just two short weeks. Pennsylvania is historically a swing state — with the winner being decided by just a percentage or two — so we cannot take a single vote for granted. **[This is our _last_ end-of-month deadline of the election, and we’ve got to lay it all on the field if we want to protect our freedoms and build a better future. name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I am writing to ask you to contribute $3 to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate. We need to help Mandela win in Wisconsin in order to expand the Senate majority. And we need more leaders like Mandela who will take on big-money interests and fight for working families. So please, chip in to his campaign today. Thanks. - B:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
#
Friends -
I'm writing to ask if you can make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. But first, I hope you will give me a chance to explain why your contribution is so important — especially today.
Here is the truth:
Defending and expanding the Senate majority depends on what happens in Wisconsin. And right now our job must be to elect more leaders like Mandela who are prepared to stand up for working families and take on big-money interests.
We are living in a moment where the people on top are doing phenomenally well while working people are struggling. We've got more income and wealth inequality today than at any time in the history of this country.
Yet in the midst of this struggle, now is not the time for despair. Now is the time for us to come together and fight back.
I am proud to support Mandela Barnes for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin because he is someone with the guts to take on the billionaire class and large corporations that have so much political and economic power in our country. If we can elect Mandela in November, it will not only help Democrats retain control of the Senate. It will also give us a strong voice fighting for working families.
Mandela is in a very close race against Ron Johnson and he needs your support to have the financial resources to win in November. Because there's only one way we will flip this Senate seat — and that is together.
That's why I am asking you directly:
[**Please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign today to help send him to the U.S. Senate and expand the Democratic majority. This is important.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=1&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=mandela-em-oct22.EgXJNr&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=21&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=mandela-em-oct22.9S-_mg&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=22&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=mandela-em-oct22.vyE4YF&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=23&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=mandela-em-oct22.TLNN8P&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=24&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=25&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
As you know, Democrats currently control the Senate. But we don't have the votes needed to pass important legislation that the American people want, and that our country needs.
But if we can expand the Senate majority in November by electing Mandela Barnes, we will be in a position to finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation that addresses the needs of the working class.
Mandela Barnes understands that the rich and large corporations must pay their fair share of taxes.
He understands that we must raise the minimum wage to a living wage of at least $15 an hour.
He understands that we need to lower the outrageous cost of prescription drugs.
He understands that we've got to make childcare, pre-K, and higher education more affordable.
He understands that we've got to defend abortion rights and codify Roe v. Wade into law.
And he understands that we've got to protect the right to vote and ensure all eligible voters can participate in the political process.
If we can elect Mandela Barnes to the Senate, we will have a critical vote to help pass legislation to address a number of important issues.
But if Republicans regain the majority in the Senate, they plan to pass more tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy, a national ban on abortion, and cut Medicare and Social Security. That would be a complete disaster.
With control of the Senate on the line, Mandela Barnes is in a strong position to win a Republican-held seat and expand the majority. But only if people like you stand with him during these final days before Election Day.
That is why I need to ask you one more time:
[**Please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign today to help send him to the U.S. Senate and defend the Democratic majority. This is important.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221025-3-sbs-gmail&t=26&akid=3768%2E196590%2EkzXcg7)
We must never stop fighting for the kind of country we know we can become. Thank you for contributing to help Mandela win in Wisconsin and expand the Senate majority.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

subject: St. Louis, “This could have been much worse”

body:
Yesterday morning, the music and rhythms of the school were interrupted by a young man carrying an assault weapon
#

Friends -
The Central Visual and Performing Arts High School in south St. Louis combines a traditional education with concentrated training in the arts.
The school is home to countless gifted young people who train daily in dance, theater, music and the visual arts.
Yesterday morning, the music and rhythms of the school were interrupted by a young man carrying an assault weapon and a dozen 30-round magazines who entered the school, opened fire, killed two people and injured several others.
According to the police, the gunman’s weapon jammed which allowed many students time and space to escape, otherwise “this could have been much worse.” This tragedy occurred despite the fact that the school had locked doors, metal detectors, and guards.
It was yet another tragic reminder that even since Uvalde, the issue of gun violence in our schools is still unresolved.
Fortunately, there is something we can do to change that in November.
Right now, we have a president who is willing to sign legislation that will make our communities, and our schools, safer from gun violence.
Now we just need a Congress with the courage to go even further than the first steps they took earlier this year.
To do that, Giffords PAC is running ads in one of the most crucial Senate races in the country. Help us expand our work:
[**Please use this link to contribute $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Giffords PAC today. We will put your donation right to work electing a Congress that will act to make our communities safer from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221025-1-15&t=1&akid=2656%2E3935704%2EOGXsVS)

My life’s work has been around one central question: What’s happening to hardworking people in America? What’s happening to hollow out America’s middle class? Why has the road to economic security gotten so rocky and steep — and even rockier and steeper for people of color? Well, here’s the answer: It wasn’t an accident. It was because a series of decisions changed who Washington actually works for. I saw a government that only works great for those with money and power — for those who can hire armies of lobbyists and lawyers. That’s corruption, plain and simple, and we need to call it out. I’m fighting for a government that works for people trying to fill a prescription — not just giant drug companies. I’m fighting for a government that works for families trying to make it payday to payday without getting ripped off — not just giant financial institutions. I’m fighting for a government that works for everyone who sees the climate crisis bearing down on us — not just Big Oil. I’m fighting for a government and an economy that works for everyone. >
Here’s how I see this: We need to make change as a country. Not a nibble here, a piece over there. Big, systemic change. The kind of change that will make this government reflect the will of the people.
And in a couple of weeks, we’ve got a big opportunity to do just that. Yes Democrats are facing headwinds, and it’s going to take a massive mobilization effort, but this isn’t unfamiliar territory.
Turnout for the 2020 election was huge. Two-thirds of America’s eligible population voted, the highest percentage in more than a century. An estimated twenty million new voters turned out. Millions of young people voted. Millions of people of color voted.
It was a massive outpouring of faith in the idea that voters — not a group of rich, distant power brokers — controlled this country.
And it made a difference.
With Joe Biden and Kamala Harris in the White House, and slim Democratic majorities in the House and Senate, we’ve started to change who our government works for.
We beat Big Pharma by allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prescription drug prices for the first time. We passed the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change, which will lower carbon emissions by 40 percent over ten years. And President Biden canceled all student debt for 20 million Americans and reduced it for another 23 million.
I’ll be the first to say there’s more we’ve got to get done, including codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law. If we can come together and expand our Senate majority, and if we hang on to the House, we can make more transformational change — not just by the skin of our teeth anymore, but as an unapologetic Democratic majority.

Not a nibble here, a piece over there. Big, systemic change. The kind of change that will make this government reflect the will of the people. And in a couple of weeks, we’ve got a big opportunity to do just that. Yes Democrats are facing headwinds, and it’s going to take a massive mobilization effort, but this isn’t unfamiliar territory. Turnout for the 2020 election was huge. Two-thirds of America’s eligible population voted, the highest percentage in more than a century. An estimated twenty million new voters turned out. Millions of young people voted. Millions of people of color voted. It was a massive outpouring of faith in the idea that voters — not a group of rich, distant power brokers — controlled this country. And it made a difference. With Joe Biden and Kamala Harris in the White House, and slim Democratic majorities in the House and Senate, we’ve started to change who our government works for. We beat Big Pharma by allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prescription drug prices for the first time. We passed the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change, which will lower carbon emissions by 40 percent over ten years. And President Biden canceled all student debt for 20 million Americans and reduced it for another 23 million. I’ll be the first to say there’s more we’ve got to get done, including codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law. If we can come together and expand our Senate majority, and if we hang on to the House, we can make more transformational change — not just by the skin of our teeth anymore, but as an unapologetic Democratic majority. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

| | | Hi friend, it’s Bill Clinton.

**I’m reaching out because there’s too much at stake for me -- or you -- to stay on the sidelines.**

Joe Biden and our Democratic Senate have done us all proud these past two years. From historic job growth to combating climate change to confirming Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court, they’ve made tremendous strides to repair the damage left behind by the previous administration.

But right now, far-right Republicans are attacking voting rights, curtailing reproductive rights, and threatening American democracy itself. If they take back the Senate from us, they’ll use that power to push their far-right agenda even further onto the American people. **We can’t let that happen.**

They’ve already told us what they’ll do if they take control. While President Biden and the Senate Democrats are cutting drug prices, giving the biggest cost of living increases to Social Security in 40 years, and protecting Medicare and the pre-existing conditions ban on raising premiums, the Republicans say they’ll cut Medicare and Social Security.

**[That’s why I’m personally asking you to join me in supporting the DSCC’s efforts to defend and expand our Senate majority. **[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61731799:JFEs-jGNF:m:1:3361486117:46C9D0DBCC773F66D5ACD29962FA3D8E:r)**

Peter,

I am just a kid from Wrightsville, Georgia, who has lived the American Dream.

Growing up, I had a speech impediment. I was embarrassed to speak up in class or to ask my teachers for help, so my grades suffered in elementary school. I lived in fear of what my classmates might do or say to me on the playground.

My parents were extremely hardworking people, but they didn't have a lot of money. They couldn't afford to send me to a private school or hire a specialist to help me improve my speech. All roads in my small town of Wrightsville seemed to indicate that I would struggle for the rest of my time in school. Luckily for me, that was not the end of my story.

_**[Will you help me win back our Republican majority?>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61731799:JFEs-jGNF:m:1:3361486117:46C9D0DBCC773F66D5ACD29962FA3D8E:r)**_

I began sitting in front of the mirror every day and reciting difficult words again and again until I got them right. Eventually, my speech began to improve, and I gained the confidence to speak up in class. I also started working out and made both the track and football teams.

After helping my high school football team win a state championship, I continued playing football at the University of Georgia. I helped the Bulldogs win the 1980 national championship, and I capped my college career by winning the 1982 Heisman Trophy. I played 15 years in the USFL and NFL for several incredible teams. I then had the honor of representing the United States in the 1992 Winter Olympics in bobsledding.

_**I am proof the American Dream is alive and well.**_

_**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save the American Dream.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61731799:JFEs-jGNF:m:1:3361486117:46C9D0DBCC773F66D5ACD29962FA3D8E:r)**_

Only in the United States, the greatest country in the WORLD, is my story possible. America is a nation built on self-determination, and no matter a person's beginnings, we all have the opportunity to reach the top of our chosen field.

Together, we can take back our Republican majority and save the American Dream for every American, no matter who you are or where you come from. But we need YOU on our team. Will you join me in this fight to preserve the greatest country in the world?

_**[Please contribute $45 to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from Joe Biden's disastrous agenda. >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61731799:JFEs-jGNF:m:1:3361486117:46C9D0DBCC773F66D5ACD29962FA3D8E:r)**_

Join MI House candidate Jodi Decker, MI Senate candidate Dr. Barb Conley, US Secretary of Transportation Pete Buttigieg and myself ahead of the canvass. No door-knocking experience is necessary. If you're unable to door-knock, come join us for a group photo and get information from the candidates about other ways to stay involved.
Sign up here [https://www.votedrbob.com/so/8cOGGKU7g/c?w=sdVJj7aeerylKHo49IzPlCpc9OyDpc2WdHMckbS9UG8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9iaWxpemUudXMvb25lY2FtcGFpZ25mb3JtaWNoaWdhbi9ldmVudC81MzUxNjEvIiwiciI6IjcxMzgyODI0LWJjN2QtNDYwOC1iYjI3LWE4MDE3YjVmMGMxZiIsIm0iOiJscCJ9] .
Hope to see you there,
The event starts at 11:45 a.m. Saturday morning and we want a lot of people to come out for a group photo and door knocking.
SIGN UP TO MEET PETE & BOB [mobilize.us/onecampaignformichigan/event/535161/]
THE EVENT IS FREE BUT WE COULD USE YOUR HELP COVERING OUR TRAVEL EXPENSES FROM NOW THROUGH NOV. 8, ELECTION DAY
Our data has us within three points of unseating Jack Bergman. His days of wedging the great people of this district against each other are over.
The reality is — Republicans and Democrats here are friends. We go to church together. Our children play on the same sports teams. We shovel each other out of the snow. I play Euchre and pickleball with my Republican friends.
Most importantly, there are common-sense political solutions that fit us all. Unfortunately, my opponent isn't interested in them and would rather push partisanship than productive policy.
I’ve had enough with division and extremism in this country, and we don’t need the incumbent to continue exacerbating the divide. I intend to reunite us and serve with dignity. bit.ly/FundDrBob [https://bit.ly/FundDrBob?fbclid=IwAR0punRoaFnLhYa7oePR7OKByPTFI-4XsCwhKhTdhn5odWUGXY2oyAsdwlc]

Hello, again! _**It's time for our economy to reward hard work, not just Ivy League credentials. **__** **_ _**Blue-collar workers are the backbone of our economy and our infrastructure. **_ In Maryland, we introduced a first-in-the-nation initiative to help remove barriers to careers in infrastructure. The _** "Jobs That Build" Initiative**_ will help Maryland keep pace with the demand for capital projects generated by federal and state investments. This $15 million investment will offer grants to workers to help them receive quality training in construction. It will also ensure that more capital projects are done on time and on budget. This initiative will help workers by:
* Giving them sign-on and retention bonuses
* Training programs
* Housing or childcare expenses

I hope this can be an example for states across the country to follow because requiring college degrees to achieve the American Dream is unsustainable and unfair to the American worker.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Speaking from the heart
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Peter, so much is at stake...
#
Peter, it’s Pramila here...
I needed to make sure you heard how I’m feeling as I campaign all over the country.
**We are officially two weeks out from a midterm election** with the power to change our country forever. Everyone is facing a choice, and we simply have to make sure voters make the right one — there’s no time to lose.
**A Democratic majority allows our Progressive Caucus to continue pushing the country forward** on the issues that really matter: reproductive rights, climate action, living wages, immigration reform, labor protections, and so much more.
We’re up against our final end of month deadline of this entire campaign, and I’m asking you to go all in with us. **Our campaign is relying on a groundswell of grassroots donations** to get over the finish line AND bring other progressives with us.
[**The next 14 days are critical, and we simply must stay strong. That's why I'm asking: can you chip in $14, or any amount, to support us in our final push?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20926?refcode=em20221025-1763&t=1&akid=1763%2E420207%2EtYcGQX)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20932?refcode=em20221025-1763&t=20&akid=1763%2E420207%2EtYcGQX)**
We cannot drop the ball now. And it’s clear that Democrats are largely being outspent in the most influential election of my whole lifetime.
**Our progressive agenda hinges on the next 14 days.** And I’m determined to do everything in my power to protect everything we’ve fought so hard for.
But none of us can do it all alone, so I need you to work with me if we’re going to win this election. We’re in this together, and we have to make every single one of the next 14 days count.
[**I believe so strongly in our grassroots movement, and I’m hoping to see our power with the donations we bring in over the next 2 weeks. Will you be one of the donors to invest in our final push and make my day?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20932?refcode=em20221025-1763&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1763%2E420207%2EtYcGQX)
I KNOW we can do this — thank you for your time and support today,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20221025-1763-footer&t=22&refcode2=1763_420207_tYcGQX&akid=1763%2E420207%2EtYcGQX)**

## Hi D. P.,
---
| | As a 1st generation Patriotic American, it is my duty and mission in life to fight for what my parents sacrificed for in coming to America. My father learned English and became an American Citizen and he took an Oath of Naturalization to defend America against all enemies foreign and domestic. Generations for America realized that there has to be a way for like minded citizens to have access to come together, discuss important issues and develop solutions for families to prosper. Inexperienced leaders in our communities need to know how to run fair and efficient meetings. For these reasons, we are offering Parliamentary training. Anyone who is serving in government or part of any organization that holds meeting, should know how to conduct a professional meeting. If you are involved in an organization and want to have quality meetings that result in decisions rather than more meetings, this course is for you as a professional or leader of a board or organization. Develop effective participatory decision-making skills. Develop skills to be able to serve as a competent committee chairman or member. Develop skills to be able to function well as an organizational officer or member. Understand the rules and how they function. Appreciate the importance of using a parliamentary authority in business and in your volunteer organizations. Assess the effectiveness of the meetings you conduct or attend. Improve the results of your meetings. Develop leadership skills through Generations for America training sessions.
---
| | | [**Join us on November 9th!**](https://www.generationsforamerica.com/so/0fO9-D6CG/c?w=METclpqpSLYAl8NcXyWkSGVhQXyW7N3WwJOXmNt_vYY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ2VuZXJhdGlvbnNmb3JhbWVyaWNhLmNvbS9ldmVudHMtMS90cmFpbmluZy13aXRoLWEtcGFybGlhbWVudGFyaWFuIiwiciI6ImVjNjIxYzZlLTU0YzUtNDliNi1hODExLTE3OTI5OGM1NGRkZCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjAzNzJiMzE5LWMzYWYtNGUxNS1hMjE2LTQ5MDFjYTVhZDUzZCJ9)
---
| | You're required to have the Robert's Rules of Order Newly Revised, 12th edition available here:[https://www.amazon.com/Roberts-Rules-Order-Newly-Revised/dp/1541736699](https://www.generationsforamerica.com/so/0fO9-D6CG/c?w=Ae8Da1ivAFpgXguNIRtDsNPIUfVNO6Dmu8cAgoYd0Vs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Sb2JlcnRzLVJ1bGVzLU9yZGVyLU5ld2x5LVJldmlzZWQvZHAvMTU0MTczNjY5OSIsInIiOiI3MjQ1ZDcxYy0wMjAwLTRkY2EtYmIwNS1iZWFkODQ4NDA4MjgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIwMzcyYjMxOS1jM2FmLTRlMTUtYTIxNi00OTAxY2E1YWQ1M2QifQ) This training is five weekly one hour sessions from Wednesday, 11/9/22 at 7:30 PM ET to 8:30 PM ET through Wednesday, 12/7/22 at 7:30 PM ET to 8:30 PM ET. and Wednesday, 12/14/22 (if necessary). Ingrid Centurion and Generations for America have arranged to have the expert Parliamentarian, Laura Meade, facilitate the workshops. What will you learn?
* How can rules protect freedom?
* What are the Parliamentary proceedings?
* The conduct of business in a deliberative assembly.
* Know the difference between a public vs. a non-public meeting
* And Much More

---
| | You can learn more about Generations for America and make a donation at the [website](https://www.generationsforamerica.com/so/0fO9-D6CG/c?w=KKY15GQdRO1Pa1qTH24B2mZQsY8AvyNidlh-Qsas0pw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ2VuZXJhdGlvbnNmb3JhbWVyaWNhLmNvbS8iLCJyIjoiZmZhYmE5ZjgtNDQxOS00ZGUzLWQyNDEtY2VjMDgxZjI3YmZiIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMDM3MmIzMTktYzNhZi00ZTE1LWEyMTYtNDkwMWNhNWFkNTNkIn0), or mail a check payable to Generations for America, 106 Waterstone Way, Goose Creek, SC 29445. I look forward to hearing from you and gaining your support to empower a generation of American families to prosper! God Bless, Ingrid Centurion

PeterI’m running for Governor of Kentucky and people keep telling me that if I want to win I have to kiss Mitch McConnel’s ring.Personally, I think Mitch McConnell needs to retire from politics and stay out of our business.If that isn’t how politics works, tough. I’m not here to fake.Can we just go ahead and talk about the elephant in the room?Senator McConnell wields a great deal of power in this country and he likes to lie through his teeth and tell the Constitutional Conservatives of Kentucky that he represents them, but he does not! Ole Mitch may be from the Bluegrass State but he does not represent us. Everyone knows he has an “R” after his name, but he looks more like the Democrats instead.In addition to working with the leftists and stabbing Kentuckians in the back in the Senate, Mitch is trying to tinker in the race I’m running in: the Governor’s race. You didn’t think he was going to sit back and be satisfied with the power he had, did you? Of course not!
So, what kind of governor are national elites like Mitch McConnell trying to put in the Governor’s office? They want a candidate that looks just like he does: weak and willing to caucus with leftists if it keeps power.
| [DON’T LET MITCH MCCONNELL HAVE MORE POWER!](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=94940877f0&e=fdefed58de)
---
You know that we can’t let Mitch get his way. He is desperate to keep me out of the Governor’s office because he knows I would stand up to weak-kneed RINOs who have sold out Kentucky and this country.In order to get elected, however, I must have your support. This race can be won but my team and I need the funds to break through the Leftist media spin about this race. We need to let the good Patriots of this state know about how I want to bring common sense and freedom to the Governor’s office.A strong Governor can make a difference not just in their state - but in the entire nation. Just look at how Ron DeSantis has inspired the nation through his work in Florida. I aim to fight as hard as Ron DeSantis. I am another candidate in the mold of Kari Lake and others, and I’ll govern as a Constitutional Conservative.We will set an example for the country so people can see what TRUE liberty looks like.However, time is not on our side. Mitch and the RINO elites are pulling out all the stops to defeat me. [**Will you step up right now and offer your grassroots support for this effort by making a generous contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, or even more to help us reach the voters of Kentucky with our winning message of anti-establishment patriotism?**](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=96cc152427&e=fdefed58de)

Just look at how Ron DeSantis has inspired the nation through his work in Florida. I aim to fight as hard as Ron DeSantis. I am another candidate in the mold of Kari Lake and others, and I’ll govern as a Constitutional Conservative.We will set an example for the country so people can see what TRUE liberty looks like.However, time is not on our side. Mitch and the RINO elites are pulling out all the stops to defeat me. | | | | | For Freedom,Eric Deters | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Breaking Conservative Daily. All rights reserved.

Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

It's game time.

| | **[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53314413/375112805/-823723624?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNDA1OWJlZi1iYzU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JD_s4E1_JlKMy5HDoJfo7JT8INU3BnAyPgPb8Vp-7KI=&emci=73a1ae20-e153-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=b4059bef-bc54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)****** Friend, **Today marks just two weeks out from November 8 — Election Day.** We have just 14 days to cast our ballots and make this election count. ****[_Make your voting plan today so you're prepared to vote in place leaders who will protect our rights._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53314417/375112811/1596049074?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNDA1OWJlZi1iYzU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JD_s4E1_JlKMy5HDoJfo7JT8INU3BnAyPgPb8Vp-7KI=&emci=73a1ae20-e153-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=b4059bef-bc54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)**** We know you've got a lot on your plate, but we can’t stress enough the importance of this election. Everything we care about is on the line. **The future of climate action will be determined by this year’s election.** If young voters fail to turn out this year, MAGA Republicans could retake Congress and advance extreme legislation to roll back progress on climate action and eliminate protections for clean air and water. If we show up and expand our Democratic majority in Congress, we can build on progress on creating good-paying clean energy jobs. **The choice couldn’t be more clear.** Just this year, President Biden has signed the Inflation Reduction Act, the largest investment in climate action in U.S. history. Every single Republican voted against that legislation. If Republicans gain control in Washington, they'll do the bidding of Big Oil and corporate polluters at the expense of our health and futures. Early voting has already begun in many states. For many, it’s time to head to the polls. **What we’re trying to say is — it’s not too late to make your voice heard. ** [**_Make your voting plan today_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53314424/375112818/-1038791483?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNDA1OWJlZi1iYzU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JD_s4E1_JlKMy5HDoJfo7JT8INU3BnAyPgPb8Vp-7KI=&emci=73a1ae20-e153-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=b4059bef-bc54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172), whether that's casting your ballot from the comfort of your home (just make sure it's postmarked in time!), voting in person at your local early vote location, or casting your ballot on Election Day. With so much at stake, it’s on us to make every moment count in these final two weeks. Thank you, NextGen PAC **P.S. Have you already voted? clean_body: It's game time. | | ** Friend, Today marks just two weeks out from November 8 — Election Day. We have just 14 days to cast our ballots and make this election count. We know you've got a lot on your plate, but we can’t stress enough the importance of this election. Everything we care about is on the line. The future of climate action will be determined by this year’s election. If young voters fail to turn out this year, MAGA Republicans could retake Congress and advance extreme legislation to roll back progress on climate action and eliminate protections for clean air and water. If we show up and expand our Democratic majority in Congress, we can build on progress on creating good-paying clean energy jobs. The choice couldn’t be more clear. Just this year, President Biden has signed the Inflation Reduction Act, the largest investment in climate action in U.S. history. Every single Republican voted against that legislation. If Republicans gain control in Washington, they'll do the bidding of Big Oil and corporate polluters at the expense of our health and futures. Early voting has already begun in many states. For many, it’s time to head to the polls. What we’re trying to say is — it’s not too late to make your voice heard. , whether that's casting your ballot from the comfort of your home (just make sure it's postmarked in time!), voting in person at your local early vote location, or casting your ballot on Election Day. With so much at stake, it’s on us to make every moment count in these final two weeks. Thank you, NextGen PAC P.S. Have you already voted? body:
Peter, As we rapidly approach the election, let me remind you that control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate are at stake. With Democrats in control of both chambers of Congress and President Biden in the White House, some new gun reform legislation FINALLY became law. In addition, sweeping legislation to strengthen the middle class, protect the environment, provide for our seniors, and so many democratic agenda items have become law. If Republicans take control of either chamber, progress will come to a screeching halt. We must protect our ground, and take more seats to ensure Democrats stay in control.

[_**Will you join Pride Fund in our effort to support the most crucial elections in the country? Every dollar makes a difference. Donate today.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/KCTaviDVg8vhlH5MtVk8SW2w6rQ-Cih3fSN5bn242no=/uCGKt0GenWi3HRAxRQHtextiVJhr7uE-BSVp-4o7XUA=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes)

In order to keep control of the Senate, and to kick out NRA puppet Senator Marco Rubio from Florida, we have to fight tooth and nail to ensure that Congresswoman Val Demings (FL-10th) becomes Senator in November. Polling shows that it is a winnable race.

We first got to know Val in 2016 when she ran for Congress for the first time. Her district is intimately connected to this organization because it is where the Pulse nightclub was, the place where 49 LGBTQ lives were lost, 53 others were injured, and countless others were permanently scarred in the second worse mass shooting in US history.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/KCTaviDVg8vhlH5MtVk8SW2w6rQ-Cih3fSN5bn242no=/F-lTrH6P_EfOw7w2oeK5jwNK-QKd78P8eOrqCbDNyxU=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes) Val's bio speaks for itself. As the former Police Chief of Orlando, so knows all too well the gun problem we have in our country and now after serving in Congress since 2017, she knows the legislative solutions very clearly. Chief Demings served 27 years and at every rank level in the department. She commanded the Special Operations division and handled the department's highest-profile tasks. She coordinated the response of the Airport Division on 9/11. She made history when she was appointed to serve as the city's first female Chief of Police.

Congresswoman Demings needs our support to win this race. The race is very tight and we have to do everything we can to help her. [_**Will you chip in a few dollars to our election fund?**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/KCTaviDVg8vhlH5MtVk8SW2w6rQ-Cih3fSN5bn242no=/uCGKt0GenWi3HRAxRQHtextiVJhr7uE-BSVp-4o7XUA=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes) Pride Fund Election Headquarters

Fellow American, I wish I had some better news...

After some phone calls and email exchanges, the sad reality is that there isn’t enough money to keep this race going.

With our polling coming in neck-and-neck, the challenge we face over these next two weeks is winning the undecided vote. To stay on pace until Election Day, we must raise $20,000 by the end of the week. And with my opponent, Jahana Hayes, **OUTRAISING** us **2:1** and **OUTSPENDING** us **3:1** , **_I don’t see much hope._**

But I refuse to give up with so much at stake. This is our chance to be a part of history and flip a seat **RED** for the first time in 16 years! subject: The majority could come down to California
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

Friends —
Today, I’m asking you to split a contribution between three California Democrats in tough re-election fights that could determine control of the House this November — Katie Porter in CA-47, Mike Levin in CA-49, and Josh Harder in CA-09.
I’ll explain more about Katie, Mike, and Josh in a minute, but if you’re already familiar and ready to help hold our majority, you can use this link to donate:
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Porter-Levin-Harder**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-plh.K9X6KV&refcode=em221025-1-90&t=1&akid=1100%2E159979%2ExWpyed)
**Katie Porter** is running for re-election in CA-47, and she’s facing more than $7 MILLION in outside spending from Republican Super PACs. She’s not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so Katie’s counting on lots of small-dollar contributions to power her campaign to victory.
**Mike Levin** is running for re-election in CA-49. He’s been a leader in the House on a number of issues, including health care access, addressing climate change, and reducing gun violence. With our help, we can re-elect him and continue making progress.
**Josh Harder** is running for re-election in CA-09. But polls show a close race with his MAGA-right opponent, and in a toss-up district like this one, every dollar has a massive impact.
[**Thank you for anything you can afford to chip in to support Katie, Mike, and Josh in their tough re-election fights.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-plh.K9X6KV&refcode=em221025-1-90&t=2&akid=1100%2E159979%2ExWpyed)
With your help, we can hold — and even expand — our majority and continue passing legislation like the Inflation Reduction Act to create good-paying jobs and protect our planet from climate change.
Holding our majority is also important because if Republicans take power, they will implement a nationwide abortion ban.
Democrats hold the House by just a few seats, and honestly, the majority could come down to just a few races in California.
So I am asking you directly:
[**Can you split a contribution between Katie Porter, Mike Levin, and Josh Harder today? They’re all in tough races and could really use your support in order to win and hold the majority for Democrats.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-plh.K9X6KV&refcode=em221025-1-90&t=3&akid=1100%2E159979%2ExWpyed)
Thank you,
Alex Padilla

body:
I don't know that there's a more important moment, in a more important
place than what's happening in Texas today.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221025-2.UQcHxS&refcode=ema20221025-214288&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=214288%2E444211%2ET_yjKW ]Please chip in now. It’ll help make sure that we have the resources to
reach the voters who are going to decide the outcome of the most important
governor's race in America.

It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been
warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped
running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes
for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon
monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they
set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.

During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest
allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it
had sold for before. Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up
making billions of dollars over the course of those five days. The kicker
is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are
all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.

This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights
on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the
nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the
leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.

Today marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were
killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one
but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst
mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and
the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who
shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.

What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme
abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in
August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This
is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal
mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely
know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of
Texas.

The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. But the
way that Texans are responding is incredibly inspiring and fills me with
optimism and a lot of confidence that we're going to win this fight on
November 8th.

People are not accepting this, they're not submitting to it, and they're
not succumbing to the temptation to despair. They're taking action and
they're showing up.

challenges, and get Texas on the right track by making a $3
donation today? I need you with us.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221025-2.UQcHxS&refcode=ema20221025-214288&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=214288%2E444211%2ET_yjKW ]Contribute $3

Thank you,

Beto

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0ab150c439a04b16af1b81ded7ce543b&_e=t0g3DSnuVPkAwlkeQ5vjcuvyyldrR80QeYBSliD_zNbV1NDylKskwRt91rgoSAFoYwbSSG6wKHdJSczi-6goXBOuOcCQavUIxxq1az3C13gqHzjj5ujWH43TS21itgiDA78Gk3LDLdWot9C_NAtUgO6w492jp82vEb8DHDGxcye4Gd0QQ-7zMLC_Znp0yHncwqHJw8FPrRSm_L1fSjbqUVfuirEMrxRpDWX51Yrguarqmn4y86GANaM9iZt_MhJPxgc5qcGj2vp9t35xcsfP64DWnaQVWJX3gYV_xNoKKZuIN4F9i_iYVQlF-r2D7Di-NQblWbWD17X5nooYOcDXFE8rDmMUu_YBzQ7tKXMvHJu4AO20u5CYxVmsCB8vUWnMA3Fof2mNUFjQayIU2S1m7A%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. President Obama just called us all to action, noting that in New Hampshire, in this election, **“the future of our country really is on the ballot.”**

And folks, I really couldn’t have said it better myself.
In more ways than one, our country’s future is at stake this November. That’s true across the country, **but by winning here in New Hampshire, we have the opportunity to make a real difference in what that future looks like. **
**[Making that impact starts with defeating Don Bolduc, and this team’s ability to do that depends on what you choose to do today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53304618/375077760/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1960-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YzQ4YzI5Yy05ZjU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ht56xRrXze6zEgIrWQdby2ewGB1-qzLmCzjIAnutDMw=)**
Let me explain – my opponent, Don Bolduc, and I could not be more different:

While I have always fought for a woman’s fundamental right to choose, he said that we should “rejoice” at the Supreme Court decision that ended _Roe v. Wade_ _._
While I have worked to make our democracy stronger, he has undermined its very foundations – spreading the Big Lie and even promising to overturn the results of the 2024 election should he be “called upon” to do so.
Don Bolduc is the most extreme nominee this state has seen in decades, and with him on the ballot, President Obama’s words have never been more true. Our future is at stake in this race. **[And with 14 days to lend your support to this campaign – be it $3 or $10 – it is still up to all of us to decide what that future looks like.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53304619/375077761/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1960-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YzQ4YzI5Yy05ZjU0LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ht56xRrXze6zEgIrWQdby2ewGB1-qzLmCzjIAnutDMw=)**

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7affce5666d14b3caa578ba376160e3d&_e=bK4SZjUtVrWfm0hQSmWesQJ90md4O1XunbvbkF5T5ACt_wCoIrlolVhcFrUifN4Mr2HgYy38BOq5txBrTFUEjhjoG3-Szov6Cp7IJ8MFAwI1paTJv8qrkgwB7CDm0iwaPAguqQsBwrlHSQ881-pG4RG9_JDSq8GypDV3SgC7O7qus3dDD7u6ymfU-tyfyX8zLMJTMJLeMiNao-mYloAN1Ro4chVY_4_gY19y5xtsb01SGO-0RkIPdyGVjQ6Ge8AZ5r98bx5GOP5GFcPZYu_k0POOCD6jI_z-XDvtbxiUmDaA4rYD_00VvW4SN4E7Ggh3XpdAmnU7VCrgt92inow8yiVLhx1W_CK2oL-4shzJAaafjR4UElq4OSlvRjFaifYOvfxcepnN0iD7dPG1shQQzw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. But we're still in the fight of our lives today with the forces of fanaticism and authoritarianism, and this is a fight taking place across America. The struggle to defend the right to vote and democratic elections begins at the state and local level. That’s why it’s critically important to elect Democratic state legislators. **I know the central importance of that role, I served as a state Senator in Maryland’s General Assembly for ten years.** **When I was a state legislator, I learned that you can be a justice politician or an injustice politician.** GOP legislators have chosen the injustice path – one that prioritizes voter suppression, dangerous abortion bans, and backward-looking anti-LGBTQ+ policies. I know that by coming together to build Democratic power in the states this fall, we can build a future that puts the needs of the American people ahead of the Trumpified Republicans’ lust for power. **But state legislative races are consistently underfunded and overlooked. So I’m reaching out to you right now on behalf of my friends at the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee to ask for your help electing state Democrats across America. As lead impeachment manager in Donald Trump’s second Senate trial, I learned that we must be emphatic about the difference between truth and lies and we must be unyielding in our defense of Constitutional democracy. But we're still in the fight of our lives today with the forces of fanaticism and authoritarianism, and this is a fight taking place across America. The struggle to defend the right to vote and democratic elections begins at the state and local level. That’s why it’s critically important to elect Democratic state legislators. I know the central importance of that role, I served as a state Senator in Maryland’s General Assembly for ten years. When I was a state legislator, I learned that you can be a justice politician or an injustice politician. Team,
If you’ve been counting down the days like we have, then you know we officially have two weeks until Election Day!
To mark the occasion, Elissa sent an email earlier breaking down all of the numbers in our race for the next two weeks. We’ve included it below, in case you missed it.
We’re at the point in the campaign where truly anything could happen – and we want to make sure we’re prepared. So, after you read Elissa’s message, we’d be grateful if you would consider chipping in. With your help, we can make the next two weeks count!
