Team Slotkin
Team,
Somehow – there are only two weeks left until Election Day. We’re really getting down to the wire, so I thought I’d break down the next 14 days by the numbers.
For a quick recap, I’m running in the brand new 7th district. It’s quite a bit bigger than the district I currently represent. To be specific, we added 3 new counties, 28,382 more people, and 1,310 more square miles. That has meant pulling off an aggressive strategy to meet as many new people as we possibly can.
At this point in the campaign, nearly all of our resources (that aren’t going into advertising) are going into our field program. To date, we’ve made 492,473 phone calls, sent 533,367 text messages, knocked on 53,820 doors, distributed 3,200 yard signs, and held 24 town hall style events. Our main focus is getting in touch with our supporters and seeing if they’ve already turned in their ballots. If they haven’t, by the time the conversation is over we make sure they have a concrete plan to make their voices heard.
In addition to our normal field program, we have our Michigan State University program. This has been solely focused on helping students at MSU get registered and making sure they have a plan to vote. We have 232 paid student organizers on campus helping us make that happen by talking to their peers in high traffic areas around campus, at football games, and in their actual dorms. We’re always hiring, so if you know any MSU students that might be interested in helping us out, send them to https://forms.gle/2n5FEVXDUg6Q6mLC9
Our other primary focus of the next two weeks: advertising. We have released 9 total TV ads so far this election, and counting. You can watch them all here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] . Getting my message in front of voters that I haven’t been able to meet yet in the new district has been critical, as they have been bombarded with negative ads from dark money super PACs about me for months.
Unfortunately, this is THE most expensive House race in the country. So far, nearly $8.5 million has been spent against me by these dark money super PACs, with another $1.5 million reserved in TV against me for the final week of the campaign alone. An insane amount that has already surpassed the spending we saw in 2020.
We’ve got a lot of work to do over the next 14 days. I know it’s felt like this election has lasted a lifetime – but if you can just hang in there with me for the next two weeks, I promise life will return to normal. And, if you want to help us finish out the next 14 days strong, consider chipping in below. In one of the most competitive House races in the country, every dollar counts! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221025_2&amount=28]

Elissa

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: What’s happening in Texas today
body:
Dear Derek,
I don't know that there's a more important moment, in a more important place than what's happening in Texas today.
Please split a contribution between CommonGood and my campaign right now. It’ll help make sure that we have the resources to reach the voters who are going to decide the outcome of the most important governor's race in America. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20221025_CGVA_Beto]
It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.
During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it had sold for before. Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up making billions of dollars over the course of those five days. The kicker is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.
This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.
This/Last week marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.
What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of Texas.
The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. But the way that Texans are responding is incredibly inspiring and fills me with optimism and a lot of confidence that we're going to win this fight on November 8th.
People are not accepting this, they're not submitting to it, and they're not succumbing to the temptation to despair. They're taking action and they're showing up.
Will you join our growing effort to win this election, overcome these challenges, and get Texas on the right track by splitting $25 donation today between CommonGood and my campaign? I need you with us. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20221025_CGVA_Beto]

[](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJwtkMFqxDAMRL9mc1OwLVmODzn00v9QLGU3NJuGtZfSv68DRYIB8RhmZLNn5oRIkQadXXFCOmz_V59jmLJjjBjyGJxPY6CpT2LnkHJiTz7dyG0n-BQAPUSCEMd3BZPaIIzl-3m-m43b0ex1yD48ZsW8hOIlT6iciMTIeys6RWGylIZ9frR21ht-3MJn3_aS8jU-Zduh_tZmz7HaoVXudtl3YN-Ory7ReVdEGCZzCFR0gSWWAN02yKK49FIdW9DrqqsBZ1agYAJ5JYPEmFEiZyzWMWVS00JQYolAk5tAsnhYkrPkkSjLOrxmPX-2fd8qX3-4XyGvUH_eWmD8)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJwtkMFqxDAMRL9mc1OwLVmODzn00v9QLGU3NJuGtZfSv68DRYIB8RhmZLNn5oRIkQadXXFCOmz_V59jmLJjjBjyGJxPY6CpT2LnkHJiTz7dyG0n-BQAPUSCEMd3BZPaIIzl-3m-m43b0ex1yD48ZsW8hOIlT6iciMTIeys6RWGylIZ9frR21ht-3MJn3_aS8jU-Zduh_tZmz7HaoVXudtl3YN-Ory7ReVdEGCZzCFR0gSWWAN02yKK49FIdW9DrqqsBZ1agYAJ5JYPEmFEiZyzWMWVS00JQYolAk5tAsnhYkrPkkSjLOrxmPX-2fd8qX3-4XyGvUH_eWmD8)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJwtkMFqxDAMRL9mc1OwLVmODzn00v9QLGU3NJuGtZfSv68DRYIB8RhmZLNn5oRIkQadXXFCOmz_V59jmLJjjBjyGJxPY6CpT2LnkHJiTz7dyG0n-BQAPUSCEMd3BZPaIIzl-3m-m43b0ex1yD48ZsW8hOIlT6iciMTIeys6RWGylIZ9frR21ht-3MJn3_aS8jU-Zduh_tZmz7HaoVXudtl3YN-Ory7ReVdEGCZzCFR0gSWWAN02yKK49FIdW9DrqqsBZ1agYAJ5JYPEmFEiZyzWMWVS00JQYolAk5tAsnhYkrPkkSjLOrxmPX-2fd8qX3-4XyGvUH_eWmD8)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJwtkMFqxDAMRL9mc1OwLVmODzn00v9QLGU3NJuGtZfSv68DRYIB8RhmZLNn5oRIkQadXXFCOmz_V59jmLJjjBjyGJxPY6CpT2LnkHJiTz7dyG0n-BQAPUSCEMd3BZPaIIzl-3m-m43b0ex1yD48ZsW8hOIlT6iciMTIeys6RWGylIZ9frR21ht-3MJn3_aS8jU-Zduh_tZmz7HaoVXudtl3YN-Ory7ReVdEGCZzCFR0gSWWAN02yKK49FIdW9DrqqsBZ1agYAJ5JYPEmFEiZyzWMWVS00JQYolAk5tAsnhYkrPkkSjLOrxmPX-2fd8qX3-4XyGvUH_eWmD8)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJwtkMFqxDAMRL9mc1OwLVmODzn00v9QLGU3NJuGtZfSv68DRYIB8RhmZLNn5oRIkQadXXFCOmz_V59jmLJjjBjyGJxPY6CpT2LnkHJiTz7dyG0n-BQAPUSCEMd3BZPaIIzl-3m-m43b0ex1yD48ZsW8hOIlT6iciMTIeys6RWGylIZ9frR21ht-3MJn3_aS8jU-Zduh_tZmz7HaoVXudtl3YN-Ory7ReVdEGCZzCFR0gSWWAN02yKK49FIdW9DrqqsBZ1agYAJ5JYPEmFEiZyzWMWVS00JQYolAk5tAsnhYkrPkkSjLOrxmPX-2fd8qX3-4XyGvUH_eWmD8)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://email.mail.candidatesnews.com/c/eJwtkMFqxDAMRL9mc1OwLVmODzn00v9QLGU3NJuGtZfSv68DRYIB8RhmZLNn5oRIkQadXXFCOmz_V59jmLJjjBjyGJxPY6CpT2LnkHJiTz7dyG0n-BQAPUSCEMd3BZPaIIzl-3m-m43b0ex1yD48ZsW8hOIlT6iciMTIeys6RWGylIZ9frR21ht-3MJn3_aS8jU-Zduh_tZmz7HaoVXudtl3YN-Ory7ReVdEGCZzCFR0gSWWAN02yKK49FIdW9DrqqsBZ1agYAJ5JYPEmFEiZyzWMWVS00JQYolAk5tAsnhYkrPkkSjLOrxmPX-2fd8qX3-4XyGvUH_eWmD8)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

clean_body: | Peter, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. # Driving For a Candidate
---
To the Editor:I drove for a congressional candidate today. It wasn’t an ego thing on the part of the candidate. I wasn’t dressed the part for appearances or driving a fancy rig. I was driving his pickup. He works 18-hour days in pursuit of the opportunity to serve. He can’t allow long hours on the road to cut into his productivity. I drove. He worked.I was volunteering my time for a candidate who I’d seen at several of his public appearances. He’d struck me as a really sincere guy who truly had the best interest of Mainers in his heart. I’d like to emphasize “the best interest of Mainers” because this candidate believes in the rights of states (most especially our state). He believes that the blanket policies issued by the federal government are often at odds with the wants and needs of the individual states. Public support for this position is borne out in our state.Consider this: Although his opponent has raised significantly more campaign money, this candidate is garnering more in contributions from actual Maine voters by 3 to 1!So, what did I learn spending the day listening to him on the phone and watching him interact with people at the places we visited? I learned that the guy in front of the microphone at an event is the very same guy as when he’s in casual conversation with friends, family, colleagues, and prospective constituents. He means what he says and follows through. I trust him.This is a man who has already given 21 years of his life in service to each of us as a Navy SEAL. When he talks about serving, he’s talking about a much higher level of service than most of us ever contemplate.Whatever your party affiliation, I encourage you to approach the upcoming election with an open mind. Our choice for congress doesn’t need to be treated like a team sport, but rather as the best path to a healthy and prosperous Maine.I’m convinced that Ed Thelander represents the stronger, more courageous, and more beneficial choice for our future.Irv TrueRound Pond

Patty’s opponent wants to blame this on the “one-party rule” in Washington D.C., but the truth is, he’s _fine_ with having a one-party rule — as long as it’s **his** party that’s in charge.
**That is the single biggest difference between Patty and her opponent.**
When Patty has seen a need for change, she has consistently been one of the first voices in the legislature to speak out. Whether voting to support critical funding for rent assistance or speaking late into the night to defend Nebraskans’ right to safe, legal abortions,**she has _never_ let her party stand in the way of real progress.**
The inaction in Congress is a failure to working families across our country. **That’s why we need leaders who are willing to hold their colleagues’ feet to the fire and deliver for their communities — not partisan pawns who will vote whichever way the money tells them to.**

| I wanted to tell you that in concert with Southern University I was able to secure **$7.62 million in funding to shore up their campus from facility-threatening erosion**. They have been having issues with subsidence that have been left mostly untreated and I needed to do something about that as their Congressman.

This $7.62 million is part of a **$35 million Bayou Baton Rouge erosion improvement project** to conserve the University's ravine along the Mississippi River. This issue not only affects the land, but also the safety of the people on campus.

Troy Carter secures over $7M for Southern University to fight climate change
| This school is a historic HBCU in Louisiana and in the country, so it's important to preserve its history and heritage for generations to come.

It's also vitally important that we continuously fight erosion along the Mississippi, especially when it comes to important infrastructure along the river. As a Congressman it's imperative that I put**investments into infrastructure, especially in areas that are most impacted by climate change. **

I hope that this is just the beginning of a great partnership with the University and I am able to continue to also work on securing funding for additional infrastructure and climate change projects in New Orleans and Louisiana.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Sixteen years ago, I suffered a rare fetal death in the second trimester of my pregnancy – and I had to undergo an emergency abortion procedure to save my life.

**Had I not had the fundamental human right to decide what happens with my own body, I might not be here today.**

And yet, Republicans across the country are steadfast in their commitment to enacting a national abortion ban and restricting life-saving procedures like mine. _I can say, first-hand, that sending anti-choice Republicans like Anthony D’Esposito to Congress will place our lives in danger._

**Abortion is healthcare. And I’m the only candidate in this race who will fight to protect this constitutional freedom for all women across the country.**

\- Laura

name: Max Steiner
subject: Good Trouble
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
I am not blind to America's history... | |
---
Hi Friend,

The campaign had a busy weekend. The POLITICAL highlight of the weekend was meeting Congressman John Garamendi in Yuba City (Garamendi's old district included Yuba City, before shifting south with redistricting). **But that's not what I want to talk about. I want to talk about "good trouble."** I know that I can come across as "too patriotic" - to the point of sounding nationalistic - to some readers (I know, because I read the replies). But I am not blind to America's history. "My country, right or wrong" is NOT "My country, always right". A good politician should know his or her history, lest they repeat it. This weekend I attended the Butte County NAACP Annual Gala in Oroville. The African American community in the United States has always been - and continues to be - under-served by the American government and under-represented in American politics. It's shameful. The NAACP was founded in 1909 to fight racism. Over 100 years later, its job is not yet done. That is not to say that the NAACP has failed the African American community. It was instrumental in desegregating schools (back when the Supreme Court wasn't full of partisan right-wing hacks like today) and pushing for the Civil Rights Act. No, it is America that has failed. America also failed the Japanese-American community during World War II. On Saturday morning, I attended the ceremony memorializing the Arboga Relocation Center in southern Yuba County. It was in converted migrant labor camps like these that a generation of Japanese Americans (many of them citizens) were collected before being sent to internment camps. We must never let that kind of race-based collective punishment happen again. I'll close by reminding you that we face an historic election this Fall. On one side, we have the Democratic Party, which recognizes that America is not perfect, but that wants us to be better. On the other, we have a Republican Party that wants to drag us back to the past, to "make us great again". In the not-so-distant past, the American treatment of African-Americans and Japanese-American was far from "great".

This weekend reminded me that we must not look backward with rose-colored glasses - our solutions must be forward-looking. Thanks for all your support, please vote. Max
Proud Democrat and Combat Veteran for Congress

clean_body: I am not blind to America's history... | | Hi Friend, The campaign had a busy weekend. The POLITICAL highlight of the weekend was meeting Congressman John Garamendi in Yuba City (Garamendi's old district included Yuba City, before shifting south with redistricting). But that's not what I want to talk about. I want to talk about "good trouble." I know that I can come across as "too patriotic" - to the point of sounding nationalistic - to some readers (I know, because I read the replies). But I am not blind to America's history. "My country, right or wrong" is NOT "My country, always right". A good politician should know his or her history, lest they repeat it. This weekend I attended the Butte County NAACP Annual Gala in Oroville. The African American community in the United States has always been - and continues to be - under-served by the American government and under-represented in American politics. It's shameful. The NAACP was founded in 1909 to fight racism. Over 100 years later, its job is not yet done. That is not to say that the NAACP has failed the African American community. It was instrumental in desegregating schools (back when the Supreme Court wasn't full of partisan right-wing hacks like today) and pushing for the Civil Rights Act. No, it is America that has failed. America also failed the Japanese-American community during World War II. On Saturday morning, I attended the ceremony memorializing the Arboga Relocation Center in southern Yuba County. It was in converted migrant labor camps like these that a generation of Japanese Americans (many of them citizens) were collected before being sent to internment camps. We must never let that kind of race-based collective punishment happen again. I'll close by reminding you that we face an historic election this Fall. On one side, we have the Democratic Party, which recognizes that America is not perfect, but that wants us to be better. On the other, we have a Republican Party that wants to drag us back to the past, to "make us great again". In the not-so-distant past, the American treatment of African-Americans and Japanese-American was far from "great". This weekend reminded me that we must not look backward with rose-colored glasses - our solutions must be forward-looking. Thanks for all your support, please vote. body:
I wanted to give you a couple quick updates as we head into the homestretch of this race:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5)
Hi there — it’s Ryan, Peter’s campaign manager, back in your inbox with this week’s Tuesday email.
We are _busy busy busy_ on the Welch Wagon doing our best to make the most of the final two weeks before Election Day, so I won’t keep you too long, but I wanted to give you a couple quick updates as we head into the homestretch of this race.
[**I hope you’ll read my reflections from the campaign trail in a few moments, but if you’ve got to go already, would you consider pitching in to Peter’s Senate campaign? Our work doesn’t stop until the polls close, and we’ll need All Hands On Deck to get there.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=3&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5)
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=4&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5) | [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=5&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5)
---|---
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=6&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5) | [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=7&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5)
We launched the Welch Wagon to motivate and inspire Vermonters to get out and vote for Peter, but I’ve got to admit this experience has given me new fuel to keep pushing in the final days of the campaign. I’ve been reminded of what we can accomplish when we come together — and also that the GOP is too often determined to drag us all backwards.
Vermont would not be exempt from the very real effects of what they’re looking to accomplish. Nothing drives home what is at stake more than my daughter. She is my daily motivation to stay in the fight for her future.
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=8&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5)
There’s a lot on the line in this election — from abortion rights to climate change and so, so much more — and we have to protect the Democratic majority in the Senate in order to keep driving our progressive vision. Giving this seat to Mitch McConnell and the GOP would have such a detrimental impact on the future of our state, and we’ve got to fight to ensure that doesn’t happen. Remember: **Republicans only need one seat to retake Senate control, and we can’t let it be Vermont.**
[**Only if you’re able, please consider donating to Peter’s Senate campaign right away. I know we’ll need the full strength of this people-powered movement to win this election.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4736?t=9&akid=1126%2E61531%2EHuN5o5)
Thanks so much for reading. Just two weeks to go!
Ryan McLaren
Campaign Manager, Welch for Vermont

Peter,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Peter, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=634b537af49a46e5bb3f6c714cba2d3f&_e=VWqFKZ2R0MWlFllE5--xhIjtTmktkMGdwvHm-kqLpBpDjav3LixNLcFDre-osPqNb911k66mEQ3G-oGjN5YYbdt2nt25_hkmqzHK7xK29_jHcXcp7xRa0UmgKPgN-LOYJMX_KM60OCEdbm_Ohk2Dk3_EKymYo0KEuypQhQsh1_nTSSGoUgEk_a3tHsJ6Qk8neEjYIqLzmP5OyTDO8six-L-xvzcbWnYu4_e_3dWGWWMQvXI7xDKLf3Lva69P0SGAsKtqTlsDEqQj1Ycnyd51oii0VUQ4ix8Q5CuB3VgC6gKNUAcoIGaxsvUPYufB8p0JUm1kD7b4rUf6LW32cXt89QKbGZunzN1V8RG7QtVOVZI25C0NVwVU7UkWGMfEky0gb6ogI0pFTSP5Mv_OW2LDxA%3D%3D) **

clean_body: The Left is desperate to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, so they came up with an “October Surprise.” We cannot let the Le | Peter, When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days. I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder , with the goal of helping others. This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles. But their ads didn't work. The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race. In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie. We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth. Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me. First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court. Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family. Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more. Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad.

Peter, Pittsburgh’s local _NPR_ station broke the story about how **Josh Shapiro’s campaign is almost entirely funded by deep-pocketed, out-of-state Leftist activists:**
“Shapiro’s expenses suggest a **targeted effort to court out-of-state donors.** His campaign finance reports list **$240,000 in airfare — including private flights** ... as well as hotel stays in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Washington, D.C., and Miami, among other locales...
The Shapiro campaign declined to answer specific questions about his out-of-state fundraising.”
Meanwhile, here’s what they said about**me and where _my_ supporters come from:**
“Mastriano’s fundraising base tightly clusters around his home base in Franklin County...
Mastriano’s campaign boasts **higher percentages of in-state donors and money** ...
More than **seven in eight of his donors live in Pennsylvania.”**
My campaign is **fueled by the people of Pennsylvania** ... because I’m fighting FOR the people of Pennsylvania.
Shapiro’s is fueled by **Leftist billionaires who think they can buy a “flyover state” like ours** ... destroy our economy, rip apart our energy sector, and manipulate our election in 2024.
It’s up to YOU and ME to stop them, Peter, but **I need your help.**

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: I'm the black conservative who will defeat her in November! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Friend, My team’s data shows we’re neck-and-neck with Ilhan Omar heading into Election Day... ...but, because we have so much to do, | | | | Ilhan Omar is uniquely vulnerable. She nearly lost her own primary...and even got demolished by the Far-Left Mayor of Minneapolis for being an entitled, selfish hack. I won’t lie to you: this district leans Democrat and conservatives do NOT make up a majority here in Minneapolis. But this isn’t a normal year, this isn’t a normal race, and Ilhan Omar isn’t a normal Democrat. A big majority of voters in Minneapolis have voted against Ilhan Omar in the 2020 Election or her 2022 Democrat Primary...and are ready to join together on Election Day to get the job done. They’re rallying behind this campaign, but we need to do more to lock up this big win over the next 2 weeks. | | | | | | | | | | | | Thanks in advance for supporting my fight to unseat Ilhan Omar! body:
[1]Charles Booker

This weekend at an event in Bardstown, a woman showed up to heckle me. She
accused me of wanting to kill babies because I don’t believe the
government should deny women healthcare.

I responded with respect. I was brought up in a Pentecostal Church, which
teaches that abortion is wrong in all cases. For many in our Commonwealth,
that is a personal belief.

But let me be clear: the government should not be in the business of
enforcing personal beliefs on others.

My mom had two ectopic pregnancies -- she’s told her story of nearly dying
because she couldn’t get the health care she needed.

This is a complicated issue. And we can’t allow the government to decide
who gets health care and who doesn’t.
